title: SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR AND AI CREATIVE PRODUCER
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR AND AI CREATIVE PRODUCER



Salary: US$1,500–$3,000/month, depending on proven skills and experience. Final compensation will be agreed upon following assessment.

Meta Ads • DTC E-commerce | Full-Time • Remote, Philippines



********Make Ads People Want to Watch—and Act On********



SurviveX is a first-aid brand looking for a hands-on SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR AND AI CREATIVE PRODUCER

who can turn strong ad ideas, approved product footage, creator content, and AI-generated elements into compelling
 and Instagram ads.



This is a performance-creative role, not simply prompt generation or template editing. You should understand what makes people stop scrolling, engage with an ad, trust a product, and take action.



We need someone who can develop original concepts from successful advertising references, produce polished videos, and understand when AI or real footage is the better creative choice.



Company Website: 

Company
: 



****************WHAT YOU WILL DO****************



1.) Analyze winning ads: Identify effective hooks, messaging, storytelling, pacing, product demonstrations, and calls to action. Adapt successful approaches into original concepts without copying protected material.



2.) Develop creative concepts: Create ad angles, short scripts, storyboards, alternative hooks, and variations suited to SurviveX’s products and target audience.



3.) Produce AI-assisted content: Use AI video, image, voice, and avatar tools to create commercial-ready assets, combining them with approved product footage and creator content.



4.) Own video editing: Deliver polished short-form ads with strong openings, engaging pacing, readable captions, effective audio, graphics, and platform-ready exports.



5.) Optimize creative performance: Develop meaningful variations, use available campaign data and feedback, and refine ads based on performance insights.



6.) Maintain product accuracy: Ensure product features, packaging, and demonstrations are accurate. Flag missing information or unsupported claims rather than inventing them.



7.) Manage production workflows: Organize source files, prompts, timelines, versions, licenses, and final exports. Communicate progress, priorities, and blockers clearly.



****************WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR****************



1.) Proven experience creating and editing video ads, preferably for DTC brands, e-commerce, or performance marketing.

2.) A strong portfolio demonstrating compelling hooks, storytelling, and professional short-form video editing.

3.) Hands-on experience with professional editing software and AI-assisted creative tools.

4.) The ability to develop original concepts from advertising references rather than simply replicate them.

5.) An understanding of direct-response advertising and how creative influences engagement and conversions.

6.) Strong visual judgment and the ability to identify and correct unnatural AI visuals, audio, and continuity issues.

7.) Excellent attention to detail, communication, organization, and independent project management.



****************What Success Looks Like****************



-Producing high-quality, original video ads ready for Meta testing.

-Delivering creative variations with clear testing objectives.

-Using AI to improve production efficiency without compromising authenticity or product accuracy.

-Continuously improving creative quality through feedback, experimentation, and available performance data.



****************HOW TO APPLY****************

Please submit:

title: Social Media & Paid Ads Specialist (Experienced)
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Working Hours: Australian Eastern Time (AET)



Minimum Experience: 5 Years (Strict Requirement)



We’re looking for a highly experienced, results-driven Social Media & Paid Ads Specialist who can independently manage, execute, and optimise organic social media and paid advertising campaigns across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Ads, and Meta Ads.



This is a hands-on execution and performance-focused role, not simply a content posting position.



We need someone who understands how to turn social media activity and advertising budgets into measurable business results, including brand visibility, qualified leads, traffic, and conversions.



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Management & Growth



-Develop and execute social media strategies across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

-Plan, create, schedule, and publish engaging, platform-specific content.

-Drive organic reach, audience growth, engagement, and community interaction.

-Manage content calendars, comments, messages, and community engagement.

-Analyse performance metrics and continuously improve content strategies.

-Identify trends and opportunities to improve brand visibility.



2. Paid Advertising – Google Ads & Meta Ads



-Independently plan, build, launch, manage, and optimise Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

-Manage advertising budgets with a strong focus on ROI, ROAS, cost per lead (CPL), and conversions.

-Conduct audience research, keyword research, targeting, and competitor analysis.

-Develop and test ad creatives, copy, audiences, and campaign strategies.

-Implement and troubleshoot conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

-Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven optimisations.

-Prepare clear performance reports with actionable recommendations.



Required Qualifications & Experience



-Minimum 5 years of proven professional experience in BOTH social media management and paid advertising.

-Demonstrated experience managing multiple business accounts and advertising campaigns.

-Proven hands-on expertise in BOTH Google Ads and Meta Ads — mandatory.

-Strong portfolio featuring real campaign results, performance metrics, and measurable outcomes.

-Solid understanding of lead generation, conversion tracking, sales funnels, and campaign optimisation.

-Ability to independently manage campaigns from planning through execution, reporting, and optimisation.

-Excellent English communication, organisational, and time management skills.

-Ability to work full-time during Australian Eastern Time business hours.



Required Tools & Platforms



-Meta Business Suite / Meta Ads Manager

-Google Ads

-Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

-Google Tag Manager

-Meta Pixel

-Social media scheduling tools

-Canva or other creative production tools

-Reporting and analytics platforms



What Success Looks Like



-Consistent improvement in organic reach, engagement, and audience growth.

-Measurable qualified leads and conversions from paid advertising.

-Efficient management of advertising budgets and improved campaign performance.

-Accurate performance reporting and proactive optimisation recommendations.

-Independent execution, accountability, and consistent delivery of results.



How to Apply



Submit the following:



-Cover letter

-Updated resume clearly showing at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.

-Portfolio or case studies demonstrating actual social media and paid advertising results.

-Examples of Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns you have personally managed, including budgets, performance metrics, and results.

-Your current location and confirmation of availability to work full-time during AET hours.



IMPORTANT: STRICT SCREENING REQUIREMENTS



Applications will be automatically rejected if:



-You have less than 5 years of proven relevant professional experience.

-You do not have hands-on experience managing BOTH Google Ads and Meta Ads.

-You cannot provide a portfolio or verifiable evidence of past campaign results.

-You cannot commit to full-time Australian Eastern Time working hours.

-Your application is incomplete or does not meet the stated requirements.



We are not accepting entry-level applicants or candidates with only theoretical knowledge.



We are looking for an experienced specialist who can take ownership, execute independently, and deliver measurable results.



Send your resume, portfolio, and campaign case studies here.

title: Etsy Customer Service & Graphic Design VA
description:
Job Type: Part Time / Long Term

Pay: $5 USD/hour — 10 guaranteed paid hours per week

Schedule: Fully Flexible / No Set Hours



About the Job



Folks Headwear is a small U.S. based business specializing in custom engraved leatherette patch hats. I'm currently running everything myself and have been the last 4 years. I am looking for a reliable virtual assistant to help with Etsy customer service and preparing customer logos for laser engraving.



I'm looking for someone dependable who can work independently and is interested in a long term position.



Responsibilities



Etsy Customer Service



Independently respond to customer messages in friendly, professional English.



Answer questions about orders, customization, shipping, and processing times.



Help customers with artwork and personalization requests.



Flag conversations that need my attention and notify me with anything important.



Check and respond to occasional customer
s.



Graphic Design



Convert customer logos into clean, solid black-and-white artwork for laser engraving.



Remove backgrounds, gradients, shading, and unnecessary details.



Clean up low-quality logos and make basic design adjustments.



Prepare high-resolution PNG files with transparent backgrounds.



Other Tasks



Help organize orders, artwork, and customer information as needed.



Requirements



Excellent written English and customer service skills.



Basic graphic design skills using Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar software.



Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Reliable internet connection and communication.



Etsy, e-commerce, vector design, or laser engraving experience is a plus. Training and examples will be provided.



Hours & Pay



$5 USD/hour with 10 guaranteed paid hours per week ($50/week), even if the actual workload is lighter.



We're currently entering our busy holiday season, so the workload may be higher initially and slow down after the holidays. Some days may require very little work, while others may require several hours.



There are no fixed shifts or required working hours, provided customer messages and
s are checked regularly and tasks are completed promptly.



Additional hours beyond the guaranteed 10 hours per week will be paid at $5/hour with prior approval.



After 90 days, I'll review performance and consider increasing pay to $6/hour based on the ability to independently handle customer service and consistently prepare accurate, engraving-ready artwork.



Additional hours and opportunities for growth may be available as the business expands.



How to Apply



Please include:



A brief introduction and any relevant Etsy or customer service experience.



Which graphic design software you use, along with examples of logo editing or black-and-white artwork.



How you would respond to a customer asking, "Can you tell me if my logo will work on your hats?"



What would you do if a customer asked a question you weren't sure how to answer?



Please include the word "LEATHERETTE" somewhere in your application.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small paid test involving logo preparation and customer service.



I'm looking for someone reliable and interested in a long-term working relationship.

• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi

WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
Position Type: Part-Time (Potential for Full-Time Conversion)

Industry: Private Family Office / Wealth & Asset Management

Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

Compensation: $7.00 – $9.00 USD per Hour + Up to 10% Performance-Based Monthly Bonus



We are seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and dependable Part-Time General Ledger (GL) Accountant to support accounting and financial reporting activities for multiple private family offices serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals and families.



The GL Accountant will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, reconciling accounts, assisting with financial reporting, and supporting day-to-day accounting operations across multiple client entities.



This position offers the potential for full-time conversion based on individual performance, organizational needs, and position availability.



Primary Responsibilities:

• Maintain accurate and complete general ledger records for multiple clients, entities, and accounts, ensuring transactions are properly recorded and classified.

• Prepare, review, and post journal entries, including accruals, prepaid expenses, depreciation, amortization, reclassifications, and other adjusting entries.

• Perform monthly bank, credit card, investment account, and balance sheet reconciliations, identifying and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.

• Prepare and maintain supporting schedules, account analyses, and financial reports, including balance sheets, income statements, and general ledger detail reports.

• Review and reconcile intercompany transactions, related-party balances, and transfers between multiple entities and accounts.

• Assist with accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense classifications, and other general accounting activities as needed.

• Review bank statements, investment statements, invoices, receipts, and other supporting documentation to ensure transactions are accurately recorded.

• Communicate professionally with clients and internal team members via
 and scheduled meetings to request supporting documentation, clarify transactions, and resolve outstanding accounting matters.

• Assist with special accounting projects, financial analyses, process improvements, and other assignments as needed.



Qualifications:



Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years of professional accounting experience, preferably involving general ledger accounting, journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial reporting.

• Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, accrual accounting, and general ledger maintenance.

• Experience preparing journal entries, reconciling bank and balance sheet accounts, and assisting with month-end closing procedures.

• Ability to review financial transactions, identify discrepancies, investigate variances, and resolve accounting issues accurately and efficiently.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and account reconciliation worksheets.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to professionally communicate with U.S.-based clients and internal team members.

• Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple client accounts, assignments, and deadlines.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining consistent communication, accountability, and timely completion of assigned responsibilities.

• High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality when handling sensitive client financial information.



Preferred Qualifications:

• Three (3) or more years of general ledger accounting, financial reporting, or bookkeeping experience.

• Experience supporting U.S.-based clients, privately held businesses, family offices, or accounting firms.

• Familiarity with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP) and accrual-based accounting.

• Experience preparing financial statement packages, supporting schedules, and month-end closing workpapers.



Work Arrangement & Full-Time Conversion Opportunity

This is a 100% remote, part-time position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be available for scheduled meetings and client communications during designated U.S. business hours. Additional flexibility may be required during month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing periods.



High-performing candidates who demonstrate strong accounting accuracy, attention to detail, effective communication, consistent reliability, and timely completion of assigned responsibilities will be considered for full-time conversion, subject to business needs and position availability.



Compensation

• Range Base Pay: $7.00 – $9.00 USD per hour depending on experience.

• Performance-Based Monthly Bonus: Eligible for a monthly bonus of up to 10% of base earnings, based on demonstrated performance, accuracy and completeness of accounting records, timely completion of reconciliations and financial reporting, quality of work, client service, and achievement of established performance expectations. Bonus payments are subject to management review and discretionary approval.



About Axis Consulting LLC:

Axis Consulting LLC is a private boutique family-owned financial services firm dedicated to serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals, families, and privately held businesses. We specialize in providing personalized financial management, accounting, tax coordination, and family office support services tailored to the unique needs of our clients. With a focus on professionalism, discretion, and long-term relationships, our firm works closely with clients and their trusted advisors to help navigate complex financial matters, preserve generational wealth, and support their evolving financial goals. We pride ourselves on delivering attentive, high-quality service built on integrity, confidentiality, and a commitment to excellence through our professionals.



Please forward to us in a message a copy of your current resume for consideration. Also include one sentence why you should be considered for this role. Should your qualifications meet our needs for an interview, a member of our team will contact you directly. Thank you for your interest.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
# WE'RE HIRING: Business Development Representative (BDR)

**Outbound Sales | Lead Generation | Client Acquisition**



### IMPORTANT: APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To be considered for this position, **all applicants must submit BOTH of the following:**



1. **Updated CV/Resume** – Highlight your relevant experience in outbound sales, lead generation, business development, and client acquisition.

2. **Introduction Video (1–2 minutes)** – Introduce yourself, share your relevant sales experience, and explain why you would be a great fit for this role.



**APPLICATIONS WITHOUT BOTH AN UPDATED CV AND AN INTRODUCTION VIDEO WILL NOT BE REVIEWED OR ENTERTAINED.**



Only applicants who complete both requirements will be considered for the next stage of the hiring process.



---



## Job Description



### About the Role



We are looking for a motivated, proactive, and results-driven **Business Development Representative (BDR)** to support the sales and business development efforts of two companies, **Easty and Eastbridge**.



Your primary responsibility will be to actively manage our existing sales pipelines, make outbound calls, follow up with potential clients, generate new business opportunities, and help convert leads into paying customers.



You will also work closely with leadership to schedule, prepare for, and assist with discovery calls to better understand prospective clients' needs and move opportunities through the sales process.



This is not just an appointment-setting role. We need someone who can take ownership of the pipeline, consistently engage prospects, build relationships, and contribute directly to client acquisition and revenue growth.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Outbound Calling & Lead Generation**

- Make daily outbound calls to potential clients from existing lead lists and sales pipelines.

- Reach out to prospects through phone calls,
s, and other appropriate channels.

- Re-engage cold, inactive, and previously contacted leads.

- Identify new business opportunities and generate interest in our services.

- Confidently communicate with business owners, decision-makers, and prospective clients.

- Handle initial objections and maintain productive sales conversations.



**2. Sales Pipeline & CRM Management**

- Actively manage and organize sales pipelines for both Easty and Eastbridge.

- Monitor incoming leads and ensure timely follow-ups.

- Keep CRM records updated with accurate notes, activities, lead statuses, and next steps.

- Identify prospects who are ready to move forward in the sales process.

- Maintain consistent follow-up schedules to prevent opportunities from being missed.

- Track lead progression from initial outreach to qualified opportunities.



**3. Discovery Calls & Sales Support**

- Schedule discovery calls with qualified prospects.

- Assist leadership in conducting discovery calls with potential clients.

- Ask relevant questions to understand client needs, business challenges, goals, and requirements.

- Gather important information that will help determine the right solutions for prospects.

- Document key discussion points and coordinate next steps after discovery calls.

- Help move prospects toward proposals, closing discussions, and onboarding.



**4. Client Acquisition & Business Development**

- Build and maintain relationships with prospective clients.

- Identify opportunities to convert interested leads into paying customers.

- Follow up on proposals, pending decisions, and outstanding sales conversations.

- Support the overall client acquisition process for both companies.

- Collaborate with leadership to improve outreach strategies, follow-up processes, and conversion rates.

- Contribute to achieving monthly sales and client acquisition goals.



**5. Sales Reporting & Performance Tracking**

- Track daily calls, conversations, follow-ups, and appointments booked.

- Provide regular updates on pipeline activity and sales opportunities.

- Report lead quality, common objections, and prospect feedback.

- Monitor progress toward sales targets and key performance indicators.

- Recommend improvements to the sales process based on prospect interactions.



### Qualifications & Requirements



- Proven experience in business development, outbound sales, lead generation, appointment setting, or B2B sales.

- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

- Confident and comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with business owners or decision-makers.

- Experience qualifying leads, handling objections, and booking sales appointments.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms and sales pipeline management.

- Ability to support discovery calls and ask effective questions to identify client needs.

- Strong follow-up skills, attention to detail, and organizational abilities.

- Ability to manage multiple sales pipelines and prioritize tasks effectively.

- Self-motivated, resourceful, and capable of working independently.

- Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.



**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience selling services to US-based businesses.

- Previous experience working with multiple brands or business accounts.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms.

- Experience supporting sales discovery calls and moving prospects through the sales cycle.

- Proven track record of generating qualified appointments or acquiring new clients.



### Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Proactive:** Takes initiative and actively looks for opportunities instead of waiting for instructions.

- **Persistent:** Consistently follows up with leads and knows how to handle rejection professionally.

- **Confident:** Comfortable starting conversations and speaking directly with decision-makers.

- **Results-Driven:** Understands that the goal is not just making calls but generating opportunities and bringing in new clients.

- **Organized:** Can effectively manage leads, follow-ups, and sales activities across two different companies.

About HireHouse:

No closing required! Your focus is to start conversations, qualify prospects, and book appointments. Our team handles the sales calls.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and power dialers.

$5 USD/Hour Base Pay: Approximately $800/month based on 160 working hours.

Our goal is to help you consistently book 2 or more qualified appointments per day, giving you the opportunity to earn $1,400+ per month!



💻 What You'll Need

- Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

- Quality headset and quiet, distraction-free workspace.

- Availability to work full-time during US business hours.

- Strong work ethic, reliability, and a positive attitude.

title: AI Developer / Full-Stack Software Engineer for a U.S. AI & Web Agency (Paid Per Project + Bonus)
description:
Type of work: Project-based. You're paid per job, not by the hour.

Hours: Work your own hours. You must reply to messages the same day and be able to join a call during U.S. Pacific business hours when needed (9 AM to 5 PM Pacific, which is 1 AM to 9 AM Philippine time from November to March).

Pay: A fixed price per project, agreed before each job starts, plus bonuses later on



We're a U.S. agency that builds two things for businesses. First, websites and search work that get them found on Google, Google Maps and in AI answers. Second, custom AI systems that catch every lead that comes in and turn it into booked work. We're hiring one experienced developer who can build both, and build them well.



This is not an entry-level job. We want someone who has already built and shipped real software for real users, and can show it.



WHO WE BUILD FOR



Bigger U.S. businesses with 10 or more staff or 2 or more locations:



- Law firms

- Bigger home service companies, like HVAC, plumbing, roofing and solar

- Medical and dental clinics

- Commercial and B2B companies, like contractors, property management, logistics and manufacturers



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD



- Websites. Fast, mobile-first business websites with service pages, city pages, schema markup, and lead forms that actually reach the owner.

- AI receptionist. Answers calls, texts and web chat day and night, asks the right questions, and books the appointment on the business's calendar.

- Custom CRMs. Every lead in one place, built around how that business sells, with follow-up texts,
s and tasks that go out on a schedule.

- Lead engine. Finds businesses that look like a client's best customers, scores them, and loads them into the CRM.

- Reputation engine. Asks every finished job for a review and drafts a reply to each new review. Replies post only after the client approves them.

- Reporting dashboards. Leads, calls, booked jobs and revenue on one screen, by location and by source.

- Custom AI tools. Quote builders, intake forms, document tools, and assistants trained on a company's own files.



HOW EACH JOB WORKS



1. We send you a written brief: what to build, who it's for, and what "done" looks like.

2. We agree on a fixed price and a deadline before you start.

3. Plan it. For anything big, send a short plan before you start building.

4. Build it.

5. Test it yourself. Run it, click through it, and try to break it.

6. Put it on a preview link and send proof it works: the link, screenshots or a short screen recording.

7. Fix whatever comes back from review.

8. Once we approve it, you get paid.



On longer jobs, send a short update each day you work on it: what you finished, what's next, and anything blocking you.



HOW WE WORK



- You own the quality of everything you hand in. You understand every line of your code and can explain it.

- Never say something works until you've tested it. Show proof.

- Nothing goes live until we approve it. You build and test. We review and launch.

- Client data and passwords stay private. Use only the accounts we give you, and never paste client data or keys into outside tools or websites.

- No fake reviews, fake numbers or claims we can't prove on any client site.

- If something in a brief looks wrong, say so. Then build what we agreed on and write down your concern.



PAY



- You're paid per project, not by the hour. Before each job starts, we agree on a fixed price and what "done" means.

- You get paid when the job is done and approved. Bigger jobs are split into milestones, and you're paid as each one is approved.

- Prices go up as you prove yourself: the quality of your work, your speed, and how little hand-holding you need.

- Bonuses come later, once you've shown what you can do. They don't start on day one. We'll go over how they work when the time comes.

- It starts with a small paid test job.



WHAT YOU NEED (all of it is required)



- A college degree. Computer Science, IT or Engineering is preferred.

- At least 3 years building software for real users, at a job or for clients.

- Real past projects you can show us: live links, GitHub, or screen recordings. School projects and tutorial copies don't count.

- Strong TypeScript or JavaScript, React and Next.js, Node.js, SQL databases, APIs and webhooks, and Git.

- Real experience building AI into products: chatbots, voice agents, or tools that connect AI models (like OpenAI or Anthropic) to a company's own data.

- Business sense. You understand that a website or a CRM exists to bring in customers and book work, and you build with that in mind.

- Clear written English, and you're comfortable on video calls.

- A good computer, fast stable internet, and a backup, like a hotspot or a second line.



NICE TO HAVE



- Voice AI or phone systems (Twilio, Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs or similar)

- Google APIs: Calendar, Business Profile, Search Console, Analytics

- SEO basics: schema markup, page speed, Core Web Vitals

- Automation tools like n8n, Make or Zapier, or CRMs like HubSpot or GoHighLevel

- Shopify development

- Working with sensitive data for medical (HIPAA) or legal clients



PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF



- You don't have a college degree.

- You don't have real past projects you can show us.

- You can't write, read and fix code on your own.

- You're an agency or a team. We're hiring one person.



HOW TO APPLY



Send all of this. Applications missing any part won't be read.



1. Put the words SHIPPED IT at the start of your subject line, so we know you read the whole post.

2. Your name, how you usually price your work, and what you would charge for each of these two jobs:

   a) a 5-page business website with a contact form

   b) a website chatbot that answers questions about a business and books appointments on Google Calendar

3. What you're best at. Your top 3 strengths as a developer, and one sentence on each.

4. Every tool you use and know how to use: languages, frameworks, databases, AI models and tools, hosting, design tools, and anything else. Mark the ones you use every day.

5. Your degree: the course, the school, and the year you graduated.

6. Your experience: where you've worked or who your clients were, for how many years, and what you built there.

7. At least 3 past projects. For each one: a live link, GitHub link or demo video, what it does, who it was for, your exact part in it, and the tech you used. If a project is private, a screen recording is fine.

8. One AI feature you built into a real product. What did it do, which AI model did you use, and what was one problem you hit and how did you fix it?

9. How you take a feature from start to finish: how you plan it, how you build it, and how you test it before you call it done.

10. A 2-minute screen recording (Loom or unlisted YouTube) where you walk us through one of your projects and explain how it works.

11. A short answer: A dental group with 3 locations misses a lot of calls after hours. In 5 sentences or less, how would you build them a system that answers those calls, asks the right questions and books the appointment? Name the tools you'd use.

12. Your resume, plus your GitHub and LinkedIn if you have them.



Shortlisted applicants do a small paid test job before we hire.



Thanks!

title: Senior GTM Engineer
description:
We're a LinkedIn outreach agency that helps B2B companies generate meetings at scale. We manage ~3000 LinkedIn accounts, run outreach campaigns, and book calls for our clients. 



We're looking for a Senior GTM Engineer to own lead sourcing, list building, and campaign infrastructure. You'll be the person who figures out how to find the right people, build the data sets, and make sure our outreach hits the right inboxes -especially when the obvious routes don't work.



What you'll do

• Build and maintain targeted lead lists for outreach campaigns across a range of industries and verticals

• Source leads creatively when conventional databases and filters fall short - scraping, enrichment, intent signals, community mining, event attendee lists, whatever gets results

• Set up and manage the technical infrastructure behind our campaigns - tools, integrations, data pipelines, CRM hygiene

• Work closely with the outreach team to refine targeting based on campaign performance and reply quality

• Identify patterns in what's converting and feed that back into how we build lists and select audiences

• Own data quality end to end - deduplication, validation, enrichment, deliverability checks

What we're looking for

• Proven experience in B2B lead sourcing and list building, ideally for an outreach or lead gen agency

• Strong technical chops - comfortable with scraping tools, APIs, enrichment platforms, and automation workflows

• Someone who's resourceful and persistent when the easy methods don't surface the right people

• Familiarity with LinkedIn outreach tooling and the ecosystem around it is a strong plus

• Able to work independently, manage your own priorities, and communicate clearly on progress and blockers

Compensation

Up to $5,000 per annum for the right person.

How to apply

Skip the generic pitch. Instead, answer this:

Tell us about the most initiative you've ever shown in sourcing a tricky lead list that conventional methods wouldn't work for. What was the target audience? Why were they hard to find? What did you actually do - step by step - to build the list? What was the result?

We're not looking for a polished essay. We want to see how you think when the standard playbook doesn't apply. If you've never had to get creative to find people, this probably isn't the right role.

Thank you

title: DTC E-Com Video Editor / Creative Strategist
description:
DTC E-Commerce Video Editor / Creative Strategist (Long-Term, High Volume)



We're looking for a highly skilled DTC video editor with strong creative strategy instincts, not someone who simply cuts clips, adds subtitles, and calls it an ad.



We need someone who understands direct-response advertising, visual storytelling, audience psychology, and retention. You should be able to read a script, understand the message behind every line, and independently choose visuals that make the ad more engaging, convincing, and effective.



This is consistent, high-volume work with opportunities for a long-term partnership.



Strict Prerequisites — Please Read Before Applying



1. Proven DTC E-Commerce Ad Experience (Required)



You MUST have experience editing direct-response ads for
, Instagram, or TikTok.



We're NOT looking for wedding editors, music video editors, cinematic filmmakers, gaming editors, or generic short-form editors without performance advertising experience.



Your portfolio must contain actual DTC product advertisements, preferably 60–150-second ads.



2. Strong Visual Storytelling & Creative Judgment



This is our biggest requirement.



You must be able to read a script and independently determine what footage would communicate each line most effectively.



For example, if the script says:



"His legs grew faster than his coordination could keep up."



We DON'T want generic footage of kids exercising or a random soccer training montage.



We want footage that visually demonstrates the actual idea, such as a young player struggling to coordinate a sudden change of direction.



You must understand the difference between footage that is simply related to a topic and footage that actually communicates the intended message.



3. Proactive, Creative Execution — Not Lazy Editing



We DON'T want:



Endless generic stock footage or random B-roll.



Static clips with subtitles as the only editing.



Repetitive talking heads with no visual variation.



Unnecessary flashy transitions that add no meaning.



Random clips chosen because their titles contain relevant keywords.



Editors who need detailed instructions for every single visual.



We DO want:



Purposeful B-roll showing real-life situations, demonstrations, emotional reactions, and physical problems.



Dynamic pacing, natural zooms, relevant close-ups, visual comparisons, and pattern interrupts.



Creative use of diagrams, annotations, motion graphics, and simple visual explanations when appropriate.



Strong visual hooks and retention-focused editing throughout the ad.



Someone who can make educational explanations visually interesting without turning everything into generic stock footage.



4. Understand Direct-Response Creative Strategy



You should understand how to visually communicate:



Hooks: Stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds.



Problems: Make viewers recognize their own frustrations.



Mechanisms: Visually explain why a problem happens.



Demonstrations: Show rather than simply tell.



Transformations: Communicate the desired outcome through compelling visuals.



Retention: Introduce meaningful visual changes and curiosity throughout longer videos.



You don't need to write our scripts, but you MUST understand how to turn them into compelling advertisements.



5. Fast Execution & High Volume



We're looking for someone with an efficient workflow who can consistently produce quality edits without spending days on a single video.



Experience with AI-assisted editing, B-roll sourcing, automated captions, or other time-saving tools is a plus.



Speed matters, but irrelevant footage and rushed, low-effort edits are unacceptable.



What We Provide



Complete scripts and voiceovers.



Creative references and examples.



Product information and audience research.



Clear feedback and ongoing work.



You will be responsible for sourcing suitable footage, selecting visuals, editing, captions, sound design, and final delivery.



Application Requirements



Please include:



Portfolio: Send 3–5 actual DTC e-commerce ads you've personally edited. No wedding videos, music videos, or unrelated reels.



Pricing: Your rate per 60–150-second video and discounted bulk pricing for 10–20+ videos.



Turnaround: How many hours does a typical 90-second ad take you to complete?



Capacity: How many finished videos can you deliver weekly?



Creative judgment test: If a script says "The heel cups stopped the pain during practice, but he was limping again by dinner," describe the specific visuals you would use to communicate this in a 5–8-second sequence.



Applications without relevant DTC examples or an answer to the creative judgment test will not be considered.



We're looking for a creative thinker who happens to be a fast editor, not simply someone who knows how to use editing software.

title: Lead Generation & Outreach Specialist
description:
About Us

Coach Mario runs a growing swim-lesson business in metro Atlanta. We help families and swimmers build water confidence and real skills, and demand is growing. We work with a remote team of online contractors across marketing, bookkeeping, and virtual assistance, and we’re adding an outreach specialist to help more families discover us.



About the Role

You’ll reach out to prospects, start friendly conversations, and guide interested people to call Coach Mario to learn about lessons. You’ll also support our lead generation and ad campaigns so more of the right families see us.



What You’ll Do

Reach out to prospects through messages,
, and social media

Start warm conversations and spark interest in our swim lessons

Guide interested prospects to call or book a call with Coach Mario

Support lead generation and ad generation campaigns

Follow up with people who haven’t replied yet

Keep accurate records of outreach, replies, and booked calls

Hit weekly outreach and booked-call targets



What We’re Looking For

Strong written English and a warm, natural communication style

Comfortable with high-volume outreach and following up without being pushy

Experience in outreach, social media messaging, lead generation, or sales is a plus, but a quick learner with a great attitude is welcome

Self-motivated and reliable, with stable internet and a backup connection

Comfortable working schedule

Basic familiarity with CRMs, social platforms, or lead tools is a plus

Experience marketing to families or parents is a bonus



Why Join Us

Ongoing work with a growing business that regularly hires contractors

A friendly, supportive remote team

Clear goals and the chance to see your results make a real impact



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include these two things in your application message:



Your resume

A 1-MINUTE INTRO VIDEO (link to Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube unlisted, with viewing access turned on)



In your video, please:

Introduce yourself

Share your experience with outreach or messaging

Tell us why you’d be a great fit for this role



No fancy editing needed. We just want to hear how you communicate!



Shortlisted applicants will receive our short screening form, then a quick chat with our recruiter, and a final conversation with Coach Mario (finalists only).

description:
Examples:

3. 



BK1ZZLE  is hiring a Short-Form Editor to own the editing and publishing of platform-native short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, etc.



This is a hands-on execution role. You will cut short-form clips that feel clean, punchy, and native to each platform, and you will manage the posting and day-to-day health of the channels you support. You will help identify strong moments from long-form footage, assist with light scripting, and support ideation.



If you understand online internet culture, pacing, hooks, and what gets people to stop scrolling, this role is a great fit.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



Editing & Execution:

- Edit short-form content for designated short-form platforms

- Build strong hooks and intros that match platform expectations

- Pull moments from long-form content and turn them into effective clips

- Edit 4 clips per week on Tiktok/Instagram/Youtube Shorts (platforms)

- Apply clean pacing, correct framing, and platform-native formatting

- Maintain clean file organization across projects and export folders

- Deliver all edits on time within the workflow set by the Lead Editor

- Assist in creating carousels, graphics, story posts, and other types of content native to these platforms





Creative Collaboration:

- Communicate quickly about gaps that impact content quality or workflow

- Participate in creative reviews and adjust edits based on notes

- Attend weekly one-on-ones with lead editor

- Support long-form editors by identifying strong moments for future short-form content



Platform Fluency:

- Stay fluent in platform trends, editing patterns, and content styles

- Understands how to translate brand voice into short-form content

- Understands the difference between entertainment and education content

- Apply brand tone, formatting, and structure consistently across all clips

- Adjust pacing and packaging to meet platform-specific expectations

- Help keep short-form content feeling fresh and competitive



Systems and Optimization:

- Use 
 to manage tasks and deliverables

- Follow SOPs for editing, exporting, naming, and publishing

- Maintain a predictable, fast short-form pipeline from raw clip to published post

- Track basic performance metrics across platforms

- Identify what types of clips are performing well or underperforming

- Apply feedback and data to future edits

- Flag major changes in platform behavior or audience patterns

- Adjust editing decisions when data shows clear opportunities to improve retention or engagement



RESULTS (KPIs & Success Metrics):

- Consistent publishing of 4 clips per week

Quarter-over-quarter improvement in:

- New audience growth

- Average views per clip

- Swipe through rate

- Leads from short-form platforms

- And other key metrics

- Hits quarterly KPIs established with manager 

- Clips delivered on time with minimal revisions

- Clean, organized file structures and project folders

- Weekly insights shared that help drive creative and strategic decisions

- Strong improvements in editing speed, consistency, and judgment over time



REQUIREMENTS:

- 2-3+ years editing short-form content for founders, creators, or brands

- Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere and Adobe Suite

- Ability to craft clean hooks, strong pacing, and high-retention educational edits

- Able to take feedback, adapt to the “content market,” iterate fast, and deliver consistently

- Familiar with 
 and AI editing tools

- Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple responsibilities at once

​​

Bonus if you have:

- Background in production, design, and/or social media management

- Familiarity with our content, our brand, and the type of educational content we create



RHYTHM

Monday – Friday 8am–6pm availability (occasional weekends)

4 clips per week

Weekly performance insights

Monthly review of top-performing clips



CORE VALUES

Core Value #1: Authenticity

Our content should feel like you’re on the field with Coach BK. Keep the real reactions, the coaching, and the personality. Use effects when they help tell the story or make a teaching point clearer.



Core Value #2: Detailed

Get the football terminology, captions, and timing right. When BK points out a DB’s footwork, show the exact step he’s talking about. A single frame can change what the viewer learns.



Core Value #3: Accountable

Bring ideas for hooks, clips, and stronger cuts. Take feedback well, catch the small mistakes before delivery, and communicate early if you’re blocked or a deadline is at risk.

About us

We’re a business specialising in rare and collectable luxury watches, serving watch enthusiasts and collectors internationally.

We produce content featuring extraordinary timepieces, watch collecting, craftsmanship, industry insights and the stories behind the watches.

While we take watches seriously, we don't believe watch content needs to be serious all the time.

We appreciate clever humour, engaging storytelling, unexpected creative moments and videos that entertain as much as they inform.

We're looking for an experienced, imaginative video editor who can bring our footage to life—not simply someone who can cut clips together.



The Role

We're seeking a talented video editor who combines technical excellence, creative storytelling, a strong sense of humour and the ability to work independently.

You'll be editing both long-form YouTube videos and short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social media platforms.

You'll work with footage supplied by our team, but we expect you to contribute your own creative judgment, ideas and improvements.

1. Video Editing & Post-Production

• Create compelling short-form videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and
.

title: Fluent Mandarin and English Executive and Operations Assistant for a Toronto Tutoring Company
description:
ABOUT EXPLORING SCHOLAR

Exploring Scholar is a tutoring company based in Toronto, Ontario. Most of our families are English and Mandarin speaking, and our weekends are our busiest time. We are looking for a sharp, reliable assistant to work directly with the owner and act as the central point of coordination across our teachers, staff, and operations.

 

THE ROLE

This is not a standard admin or call-center job. You will work side by side with the owner, take the growing to-do list off their plate, and make sure things actually get done. You will coordinate between teams, follow up on open items, and keep everything moving. You will not be the main person answering every parent call or booking every class, but you will be the person who keeps it all connected.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Act as the central coordination point between the owner, teachers, and staff

- Turn the owner's instructions into a clear, prioritized to-do list, then work through it one task at a time

- Execute on tasks quickly and correctly, with minimal follow-up needed

- Write clear SOPs (standard operating procedures) from the instructions and examples the owner gives you

- Support teacher recruitment and onboarding

- Communicate in Mandarin with our Mandarin-speaking staff member and, when needed, with Mandarin-speaking families

- Step in on phone, WeChat, and scheduling tasks when the owner needs support

- Keep shared documents, trackers, and records organized in Google Workspace

 

MUST HAVES

- Fluent spoken and written Mandarin AND fluent spoken and written English. Both languages are mandatory, and you will be assessed on both.

- Proven experience as an executive assistant, operations assistant, or similar role

- Proven experience working night shifts as a remote worker

- Fast learner who picks up new tools and processes quickly

- Able to juggle many tasks at once and coordinate multiple people without dropping details

- Strong written communication, and able to document processes clearly

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

- Very comfortable using AI tools in your everyday work, and able to tell us your skill level and give real examples of how you use them

- Comfortable on the phone and with WeChat

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a headset, with a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available during the coverage hours listed below

 

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience in education, tutoring, or a service business

- Experience with Chinese-language customer support or a bilingual BPO

- Experience building SOPs or training materials

 

SCHEDULE

- Full-time engagement, about 8 billable hours per day

- 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time (hours follow Toronto's clock, including daylight saving changes), with a one-hour unpaid break

- Thursday to Monday, with Tuesday and Wednesday off (flexible weekday rest day).

- This is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so please only apply if this works for you long term

 

COMPENSATION

- Monthly rate of CAD $1,700 to $2,400, depending on experience

- Paid monthly through Wise, at the beginning of the following month for the full previous calendar month

- A 13th month payment after one full year of working together

 

ENGAGEMENT TYPE

This is an independent contractor engagement under a written service agreement. You are responsible for your own taxes and registrations, you provide your own computer, headset, and internet, and you send a simple invoice each month.

 

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please send all of the following. Applications without these will not be reviewed.

 

1. Your resume and a short note on why you fit this role

2. A Loom video of no more than 5 minutes in which you: introduce yourself in Mandarin and then in English; describe your comfort level with AI tools (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), the tools you use, and one specific time AI dramatically increased your efficiency at work; describe a time you built an SOP or took a messy to-do list and got it done; and confirm you can work 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time, Thursday to Monday

3. Your expected monthly rate in Canadian dollars

 

Start your application with the word "Scholar" so we know you read the whole post.

 

HIRING PROCESS



1. Stage 1, application review

2. Stage 2, practical task: shortlisted applicants receive a realistic scenario and record a second Loom video of up to 5 minutes, sharing their screen while they work. You will be given a messy list of owner requests with conflicting priorities. Show us how you would turn it into a prioritized plan, draft a short SOP for one of the requests from a few rough bullet points, and write one short WeChat reply in Mandarin to a parent whose class was cancelled. Talk through your thinking out loud as you go, and show us how you use AI tools during the task if you choose to.

3. Stage 3, live interview: the top candidates have a live phone or video interview that includes a conversation in English and Mandarin

title: Engineering Team Coordinator (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering team coordinator who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

• Worked alongside TPMs or Product Managers

title: Video Editor — Storytelling, Interviews & B2B Content
description:
Remote | Project-Based / Part-Time as Needed | Long-Term Opportunity



About Us



We're a Canada-based video production business creating story-driven video content for companies and organizations.



Our projects include brand stories, client testimonials, interviews, educational content, and short-form videos for B2B companies and nonprofit organizations.



We're looking for an experienced video editor to collaborate with us on a project-by-project basis, with the potential for a long-term working relationship.



This is not a position focused on trendy TikTok edits or high-volume social media content. We're looking for someone who understands storytelling and knows how to turn real conversations into engaging, meaningful videos.



What We're Looking For



1. Strong English comprehension and proven interview storytelling experience — essential



This is our number one priority.



You must have previous experience independently editing interview-driven videos and building stories from raw footage. We're not looking for someone who needs to learn the fundamentals of storytelling from scratch.



You should be able to:



- Understand English-language interviews, including different accents, natural speech, and complex business topics.

- Review raw interviews and independently identify the strongest ideas, quotes, and meaningful moments.

- Build a compelling story arc based on the video's purpose, audience, and key message.

- Turn long conversations into clear, engaging narratives without changing the speaker's intended meaning.

- Recognize what to cut, what to keep, and where a pause or transition helps the story.

- Explain your editorial choices and suggest improvements when something isn't working.



You should already have your own approach to reviewing interviews, selecting footage, and developing a narrative.



We'll provide creative briefs, project context, brand guidelines, and direction. We're also happy to share our internal workflow and collaborate on improving the process, but we expect you to bring established editorial skills and independent creative judgment.



2. A modern, refined editing style



Our work sits somewhere between traditional corporate video and contemporary digital storytelling.



We want videos that feel professional, polished, and credible, but never generic, outdated, or overly corporate.



We're looking for an editor with a strong creative eye who understands:



- Thoughtful pacing and engaging visual storytelling.

- Creative and purposeful use of B-roll.

- Clean, tasteful motion graphics and animation.

- Smooth transitions that feel intentional rather than distracting.

- Music selection that supports the story and avoids generic corporate soundtracks.

- Strong sound design and audio mixing.

- Consistent, professional color correction and grading.



We value creativity and attention to detail, but we don't believe every video needs flashy effects, constant zooms, or excessive animation.



Every creative decision should serve the story.



3. Technical skills and reliability



- Experience with DaVinci Resolve preferred.

- Comfortable working with multicamera interviews and separate audio recordings.

- Ability to organize footage, project files, and deliverables.

- Comfortable working from creative briefs, brand guidelines, and reference videos.

- Strong attention to detail and quality control.

- Clear communication in written English.

- Ability to work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and meet agreed deadlines.

- Willingness to receive feedback and collaborate through revisions.



 What You'll Be Working On



Projects may include:



- Interview-driven B2B videos.

- Brand stories and company profiles.

- Client testimonials and case studies.

- Nonprofit and community impact stories.

- Educational and thought-leadership content.

- Short-form videos adapted from longer interviews.



Some projects will come with a prepared rough cut and will require final editing, B-roll, graphics, sound design, and color grading.



Other projects may involve reviewing raw interview footage, selecting the strongest material, and developing an initial story structure.



 Working Arrangement



This is a remote, project-based opportunity, not a full-time position.



We're currently looking for an additional editor to support our production workload as projects come up. Work volume may vary from month to month, so consistent weekly hours are not guaranteed.



Our goal is to build a reliable, long-term collaboration with someone who cares about quality, storytelling, and the creative process.



Compensation: The hourly rate listed is a starting reference. We're open to discussing rates based on your experience, skill level, and the scope of each project. Both hourly and project-based arrangements are possible.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. 2–3 complete video projects that best demonstrate your storytelling and editing skills. Interview-based, documentary-style, branded, or educational content is especially relevant. Please don't send only a showreel.

2. A short explanation of your specific role in those projects. Did you select the interview clips and build the story, or were you working from a prepared script or rough cut?

3. Your experience working with English-language interviews and building narratives from raw footage.

4. Your editing software and typical workflow.

5. Your hourly rate in USD and whether you're open to project-based work.



Please note: Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid editing test using provided footage.



We're looking for someone with a strong editorial instinct, a modern creative perspective, and genuine attention to detail — someone who understands that great editing isn't just about how a video looks, but how effectively it communicates a story.

title: Cold Caller & Cold Email Outreach / Appointment Setter for US Real Estate Media
description:
Landing Nest Media is a growing real estate media company in Massachusetts and New Hampshire, USA. We create listing photos, video, drone, and floor plans for top real estate agents, as well as do personal branding. We are hiring an outreach specialist to join our sales team: you will cold call AND cold
 real estate agents and book appointments for us.



This is a real position on a growing team, with training, scripts, templates, and target client lists. If you are confident on the phone, sharp in writing, and you like hitting targets, keep reading.



What you will do

- Make 100 outbound cold calls per day to real estate agents in our market. You build your daily call list from Zillow and 
 using our criteria (agents with active listings that are missing key media, like video or a 3D tour), and you will also work a Top 200 agent list that we provide

- Run cold
 outreach to agents using our templates and tools: send the sequences, watch for replies, and work every interested reply toward a booked call

- Follow our proven call script: introduce Landing Nest Media, ask about their current listing photos and video, and find what their listings are missing

- Book follow-up calls and shoots on our system (Tonomo)

- Log every call outcome in our CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day

- Check the CRM before you contact any agent, and keep every agent record current. Each agent has exactly one owner on our team, so no agent is ever contacted by two of us, and existing clients are never cold called

- Send short follow-up texts to agents between calls using our templates

- Stay in contact with the clients you bring in, like a client success manager: check in with them, keep the relationship warm, and help them book again. Your commission depends on their repeat bookings (see pay structure), so this is part of the job, not extra.

- Report your numbers daily: dials, conversations,
s sent, replies, bookings



Our benchmark from top performers in this exact role: 100 dials leads to about 25 real conversations and 1 to 5 bookings per day. We care about conversations and bookings, not just dials.



What we provide

- Your target criteria and a Top 200 agent list (you build your daily list from Zillow and 
), call scripts,
 templates, and objection handling training

- First-week training directly with the company owner

- CRM and dialer access

- Daily coaching and feedback from our team

- A clear scoreboard so you always know where you stand



What we need from you

- Fluent, clear spoken English suitable for US business calls

- Strong written English for cold
: clean grammar, short sentences, professional tone

- Experience in cold calling, cold
 outreach, telemarketing, or appointment setting (real estate experience is a plus, not required)

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset

- Comfortable working US Eastern Time hours, starting at 9:00 AM ET (this is a night shift from the Philippines)

- Thick skin, high energy, and coachable: you will get feedback and we expect it applied the same day

- Stable and looking for long-term work, not short gigs



Pay and structure

- $4/hour USD, paid biweekly (via Wise)

- Pay growth, built in: raise to $5/hour at 90 days. Raise to $6/hour at 13 months if you have consistently hit your 100 calls a day on every working day (weekdays only; no weekend work in this role)

- Commission on the clients you lock in, paid on what they book:

  - Their 1st shoot: 100% of the shoot value. If they book a $600 shoot, you earn $600.

  - Their 2nd shoot: 15% commission

  - Their 3rd shoot: 10% commission

  - Their 4th shoot: 5% commission

  - After the 4th shoot: no further commission on that client

- Why it works this way: we want you keeping your clients happy and rebooking, like a client success manager, and we want you always hunting new clients too. Worked example on a client who books four $600 shoots: you earn $600 + $90 + $60 + $30 = $780 from that one client.

- Commission timing: commission is earned and paid after the client's payment for that shoot has been received. A booking that cancels or never pays earns no commission.



How to apply

Reply with:

1. A 1-2 minute voice recording introducing yourself (this is required; applications without audio will not be reviewed)

2. A short writing sample: a 4-5 sentence cold
 you would send a real estate agent to introduce a media company (this is required too)

3. Your cold calling and cold
 experience: what you sold, how many dials and
s per day, your results

4. Your internet speed and work setup

# HIRING: Creative Scriptwriter & Content Brief Specialist (Remote)



We’re a fast-growing social media marketing agency looking for a highly creative, organized, and detail-oriented **Scriptwriter & Content Brief Specialist** to join our remote creative team.



This is not a basic copywriting or caption-writing position.



We’re looking for someone who understands social media content, video storytelling, and creative production. You should be able to take raw footage, client information, announcements, and creative ideas and turn them into clear, engaging scripts and detailed briefs that our video editors and graphic designers can execute.



Our team works across multiple client accounts, including publicly traded companies, restaurants, consumer brands, and other businesses.



We need someone who can think creatively, work independently, and consistently produce high-quality work without needing constant direction.



## What You'll Be Responsible For:



- Write engaging scripts for short-form videos, reels, advertisements, and promotional content.

- Create detailed post-production scripts using existing footage, interviews, and other video assets.

- Review raw footage and identify compelling moments, storytelling opportunities, and potential content ideas.

- Develop video structures that include hooks, storytelling, transitions, B-roll recommendations, on-screen text, and calls to action.

- Provide clear editing instructions so video editors understand exactly how each video should be produced.

- Create detailed creative briefs for graphic designers, including headlines, supporting copy, messaging, design direction, and visual references.

- Turn client announcements, press releases, events, and updates into engaging social media content.

- Research client industries, competitors, and relevant trends to develop creative content ideas.

- Understand and adapt to different client voices, industries, and audiences.

- Repurpose existing footage and content into additional video concepts and graphic opportunities.

- Work closely with video editors, graphic designers, strategists, and creative leadership.

- Revise scripts and briefs based on feedback while maintaining consistency and quality.

- Ensure scripts and briefs are accurate, complete, and ready for production before being assigned.

- Manage multiple creative assignments across different client accounts while meeting deadlines.



## What We're Looking For:



We are specifically looking for someone who is:



- **Creative** — you know how to make content interesting, engaging, and attention-grabbing.

- **A strong storyteller** — you understand how to structure videos that keep people watching.

- **Detail-oriented** — your scripts and briefs provide enough direction for the creative team to execute properly.

- **Proactive** — you identify content opportunities and suggest ideas without waiting to be told.

- **Extremely organized** — you can manage multiple scripts, briefs, and deadlines simultaneously.

- **A strong writer** — your written English is excellent, clear, and professional.

- **Research-driven** — you can learn about unfamiliar industries and turn complex information into understandable content.

- **Adaptable** — you can switch between different brands, industries, and creative styles.

- **Independent** — you do not need someone walking you through every assignment.

- **Solutions-focused** — you think through creative challenges instead of simply passing them to someone else.



We want someone who understands that great content starts with great creative direction.



## Requirements:



- Previous experience in video scripting, content writing, creative production, or a similar role.

- Strong understanding of social media platforms, especially Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.

- Experience writing scripts for short-form video content.

- Ability to create detailed post-production scripts and editing instructions.

- Experience preparing creative briefs for graphic designers.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Understanding of video editing concepts, pacing, storytelling, and visual composition.

- Ability to research and write about multiple industries.

- Experience working with a marketing agency, creative team, or production company strongly preferred.

- Comfortable managing multiple creative assignments simultaneously.

- Reliable computer and internet connection.

- Comfortable working consistent hours that overlap with a U.S.-based team.

- Experience with tools such as 
, Google Drive, 
, Figma, or similar platforms is a plus.

- Familiarity with AI writing and research tools is a plus, but the ability to think creatively and write independently is essential.



## This Role Is NOT For You If:



- You only know how to write captions or basic social media posts.

- You rely entirely on AI to generate your work without reviewing or improving it.

- You cannot understand how a video should flow from beginning to end.

- You struggle to turn raw footage into a compelling story.

- You write vague briefs that leave editors and designers confused.

- You need constant instructions for every creative assignment.

- You cannot adapt your writing style to different clients.

- You regularly miss deadlines or require constant reminders.

- You submit work without checking accuracy, spelling, or quality.

- You are uncomfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.



We are not looking for someone to simply write words.



**We are looking for someone who can turn ideas, footage, and information into production-ready creative content.**

**Full-time remote position.**



You must be comfortable working hours that overlap with our U.S.-based team.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview process.

Competitive monthly compensation based on experience.

# TikTok News Editor — Memes & B-Roll



**PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



**Your FIRST message must include your COMPLETED editing assessment.**



Please do not message me just saying "I'm interested," "I want to apply," or sending only your resume.

## Who I'm Looking For



I'm looking for a creative short-form video editor who understands **American internet humor, TikTok/YouTube news commentary, memes, and how to find the EXACT clips that match what someone is talking about.**



I'm not looking for someone who only cuts pauses and adds captions.



I need someone who can listen to my commentary, understand the story, independently research the right footage, and make creative editing decisions.



For example, if I'm talking about an affiliate commission issue, I want the actual commission screen recording—not a random company logo.



If I'm discussing a creator's AI tool, I want that creator's original video—not generic AI footage.



**The ability to find the right visuals and understand comedic timing is the most important part of this job.**

1. Editing my raw talking-head footage into complete episodes.

2. Independently finding original TikTok videos, articles, screenshots, screen recordings, and relevant memes.

3. Creating professional vertical split-screen videos with supporting footage on top and me talking on the bottom.
