title: Tax Accountant
description:
Tax Accountant – Private Family Office Wealth

Axis Consulting LLC

Position Type: Part-Time (Potential for Full-Time Conversion)

Industry: Private Family Office / Wealth & Asset Management

Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

Compensation: $9.00 USD per Hour + 10% Performance-Based Monthly Bonus



Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and client-focused Part-Time Tax Accountant to support multiple private family offices serving high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) individuals and families.

The ideal candidate will have experience in individual, trust, estate, partnership, and investment-related taxation, along with exceptional client-facing communication skills. This role involves direct client interaction, tax preparation and compliance, and coordination with external tax advisors and family office professionals.

This position offers the potential for full-time conversion based on individual performance, organizational needs, and position availability.



Primary Responsibilities

• Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, proactively requesting tax documentation (PBC lists), communicating via phone and
, and following up on outstanding items to ensure timely tax compliance and exceptional client service.

• Prepare and review federal and state tax returns for HNW individuals, trusts, estates, partnerships, LLCs, corporations, and other family-owned entities.

• Prepare quarterly estimated tax calculations, annual tax projections, and related payment schedules.

• Review financial statements, general ledgers, investment statements, Schedules K-1, Forms 1099, and other supporting tax documentation.

• Support tax planning related to investment income, capital gains, trusts, estates, wealth transfers, and family-owned entities.

• Research federal and state tax regulations and assist with tax notices, audits, and multistate reporting requirements.

• Coordinate with external CPAs, tax attorneys, wealth advisors, and family office accounting teams to facilitate tax preparation and compliance.

• Maintain organized tax records, track filing deadlines, and manage outstanding client requests and deliverables.

• Assist with tax-related reconciliations, year-end adjustments, and special projects as assigned.



Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years of tax preparation, compliance, or accounting experience, preferably serving HNW individuals, trusts, partnerships, or privately held entities.

• Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state individual, partnership, and fiduciary taxation, including Forms 1040, 1041, 1065, and 709.

• Exceptional client-facing communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to professionally engage HNW clients, clearly communicate documentation requirements, and proactively manage follow-ups.

• Familiarity with investment-related tax reporting, including capital gains, investment income, and Schedules K-1; Form 1065.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data analysis, and reconciliations, and other tax preparation software.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality when handling sensitive client financial information.



Preferred Qualifications

• Four (4) or more years of tax preparation, compliance, or accounting experience, preferably serving HNW individuals, trusts, partnerships, or privately held entities.

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

• Experience in a single-family office, multi-family office, private wealth management firm, or public accounting practice serving HNW/UHNW clients.

• Knowledge of estate and gift taxation, family investment partnerships, trusts, real estate, and alternative investments.

• Experience with CCH Axcess, ProSystem fx, UltraTax, or similar tax software.



Work Arrangement & Full-Time Conversion Opportunity

This is a 100% remote, part-time position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be available for scheduled meetings and client communications during designated U.S. business hours. Additional flexibility may be required during peak tax seasons and filing deadlines.

High-performing candidates who demonstrate strong technical expertise, exceptional client service, and consistent reliability will be considered for full-time conversion, subject to business needs and position availability.

title: Operations and Reporting Coordinator
description:
Operations and Reporting Coordinator

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Operations Lead.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll keep the back end of our business right: the numbers we d
 on, the products we list, and every order after the customer clicks Buy. You'll prepare our daily sales and ads reports, be our warehouse's main contact, answer our customers, and keep our listings and catalogs accurate on every channel. You'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations, and take vendor follow-up and day-to-day execution off her plate.



This role is half care and half precision. You need to be warm with a customer and politely persistent with a vendor, and you need to refuse to upload, send or pay anything when a number doesn't match its source. The most valuable thing you do is catch the mistake before it goes live.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag anything that doesn't add up.

• Orders and the warehouse: keep orders moving across our store, Amazon and retail partners, be our warehouse's main contact, check the returns, files and invoices it sends us, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims, and look after our product reviews.

• Inventory and listings: keep stock files, product listings, our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs and approved promotions accurate on every channel, checked against our master sheet.

• Production support: get our weekly production meeting ready, and prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs.

• Returns and tickets: reconcile returns and refunds, and follow every open support ticket until it's fixed.

• Systems and SOPs: write down every step you own, keep our trackers current, help set up new sales channels, and run the automations we approve.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• You can trace every number. Ask where a figure came from and you can show the source. You're comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• 2+ years reconciling or reporting operational data: inventory, orders and invoices, e-commerce reporting, or marketplace operations.

• Hands-on e-commerce listing experience: Amazon flat files, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• Customer care for an online brand: order questions, refunds, returns and warranty claims, written warmly and clearly.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• A builder: when something was never written down, you write it down and make it the standard.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, retailer vendor portals, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a warehouse.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every listing and catalog matches our master sheet.

• Every open vendor issue and support ticket has a next step.

• Every recurring step is written down.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.

The landlord will normally select contractors, discuss work directly and approve quotations and expenditure. You will contact contractors or arrange work only when instructed or under an agreed routine procedure.

• Administer routine compliance appointments, such as annual gas-safety checks, using approved contractors and documented procedures. Escalate failures, remedial work, costs and uncertainties.

• Maintain accurate property and tenancy files, certificates, inspection records and compliance reminders.

• Check licensing requirements with the relevant local council; prepare applications and renewals, track licence conditions and retain evidence.

• Coordinate arrears follow-up using payment information supplied by our finance colleague.

• Prepare approved tenant letters, rent-review paperwork and draft formal notices for the landlord's review.

• Monitor relevant changes, including Renters' Rights Act processes and government rental-property registration requirements as they become applicable.

• Provide a concise weekly report covering outstanding matters, upcoming deadlines and decisions required.

• Depending on portfolio needs, assist with Airbnb or short-let guest communication and approved outreach to potential business clients.



New lettings and tenancy setup



When a property needs letting, you will coordinate advertising, enquiries, local viewings, referencing, Right to Rent checks, current tenancy documentation, deposit administration, prescribed information and move-in arrangements.



You will develop and maintain a checklist using current NRLA, 
 and relevant council guidance, tailored to each property and tenancy. Every step should identify its deadline, responsible person, required evidence, completion date and any approval needed.



Systems and resources



We have NRLA membership, including guidance, templates, checklists and access to advice, as well as other landlord resources. We are considering NRLA Portfolio but have not yet selected or configured the final management system.



Routine physical letters may be sent remotely using an approved service. Serious legal documents will be reviewed and handled by the landlord, with copies, posting evidence and follow-up retained in the records.



Potential future responsibility



If we develop a “sell my house quickly” enquiry portal, the role may later include maintaining records of homeowners contacted, setting follow-up reminders, preparing and sending approved follow-ups, and flagging enquiries requiring the landlord's attention. Tenancy management, licensing and compliance will remain the main priorities, and hours will be reviewed if this additional work grows.



Experience and working arrangements



Direct experience supporting UK landlords or letting agencies—particularly English residential tenancies—is strongly preferred. Excellent written English, careful record-keeping, initiative, sound judgement and reliable follow-through are essential.



We anticipate approximately 5–15 hours per week. Hours will vary according to workload and are not guaranteed. The initial setup period, new lettings and significant compliance projects may require additional time. If the work is likely to exceed 15 hours in any week, this must be raised with us and approved in advance before any additional hours are worked.



Administrative work can be completed flexibly. However, communication with tenants, contractors, Airbnb or short-let guests and prospective business clients must take place during appropriate UK working hours. You must also be available for agreed training and meetings with some UK-hours overlap.



This role requires prompt, dependable communication. You must acknowledge work messages, confirm agreed meetings, answer all questions in a message and notify us in advance of any delay or availability issue.



Pay is US$5 per hour for actual time spent on assigned or agreed tasks, tracked through Hubstaff. This is intended as an ongoing, variable-hours part-time role rather than a full-time position.



The landlord will approve tenants, rents, contractors, significant expenditure, remedial works and formal legal action. Local contractors or agents will handle physical visits and works. You must recognise when specialist or legal advice is required.



To apply, please answer these questions:



1. Describe your direct experience with UK residential property, landlords or letting agencies. Which tenancy and compliance tasks have you personally handled?

2. How would you create an auditable system showing each obligation, deadline, responsible person, evidence and completion date?

3. If asked whether a property needs a council licence, how would you research and document the answer?

4. Give an example of a repair, tenant issue or compliance matter that you followed through from first report to verified completion.

5. What are your current work commitments, and what exact hours can you provide during UK working hours?

6. What backup arrangements do you have for internet or power interruptions?

7. Please confirm that you understand and accept the US$5 hourly rate and variable workload of approximately 5–15 hours per week.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short paid practical assessment.

title: BHA billing Specialist
description:
Safe Counseling PSC is  (BHA) seeking an experienced Behavioral Health Facility Billing Specialist to manage insurance claims, billing, reimbursement, and revenue cycle operations.



We are specifically looking for someone with direct experience billing for licensed behavioral health agencies, mental health facilities, or community behavioral health organizations.



This is NOT a traditional private practice or group practice billing position. Candidates must understand the differences between billing under an individual or group provider and billing under a licensed behavioral health agency/facility.



Key Responsibilities



Prepare, submit, and track facility/agency-level behavioral health insurance claims.



Submit Medicaid claims and commercial insurance through Washington ProviderOne and Availity or applicable MCO payer portals



Understand the appropriate use of CMS-1500 (837P) versus UB-04 (837I) claims based on payer contracts and covered services.



Verify correct use of agency Type 2 NPI, taxonomy, billing provider, rendering provider, service facility, and payer-specific billing requirements.



Submit claims for mental health assessments, individual therapy, behavioral health support, peer support, and other authorized outpatient behavioral health services.



Understand billing requirements for intensive outpatient programs (IOP) and other facility based behavioral health services.



Identify and correct rejected or denied claims, including provider enrollment, taxonomy, authorization, coding, and credentialing-related errors.



Verify Medicaid eligibility, managed care enrollment, authorization requirements, and payer reimbursement rules.



Review remittance advice, reconcile payments, and follow up on unpaid claims.



Maintain accurate billing records and ensure compliance with Washington HCA, Medicaid, and payer policies.



Coordinate with agency leadership and credentialing specialists to resolve billing and contracting issues.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 2 years of hands-on billing experience with licensed behavioral health agencies, community mental health agencies, or comparable behavioral health facilities.



Direct experience submitting claims under an organizational/facility NPI.



Working knowledge of Washington State Medicaid (Apple Health), ProviderOne, and Medicaid managed care plans.



Experience with behavioral health HCPCS and CPT codes, including H-codes.



Understanding of BHA enrollment, payer contracting, agency billing, and reimbursement requirements.



Experience resolving facility-related claim denials and rejections.



Familiarity with Availity, ProviderOne, and electronic health record billing systems.



Strong understanding of HIPAA, billing compliance, and documentation requirements.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous billing experience with a  DOH-licensed Behavioral Health Agency.



Experience with mental health intensive outpatient programs (IOP).



Experience billing Medicaid MCOs, including Coordinated Care, Molina, CHPW, UnitedHealthcare Community Plan, and Wellpoint, where applicable.

title: E-commerce Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role



EVORETRO is looking for a results-driven and strategic Marketing Manager to lead and oversee all end-to-end marketing operations across our e-commerce platforms, digital marketing channels, social media, paid advertising, influencer partnerships, and events.



This role is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies aligned with the company's business goals, managing the performance of the marketing team, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring that all marketing activities contribute to brand awareness, customer engagement, traffic, and revenue growth.



The ideal candidate is both strategic and hands-on, capable of leading a team of specialists, managing multiple marketing initiatives, monitoring performance metrics, and continuously improving marketing processes and results.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Marketing Strategy & Department Management

- Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies, campaigns, and initiatives aligned with company objectives.

- Oversee the entire marketing department, including planning, execution, performance monitoring, and reporting.

- Establish marketing goals, KPIs, budgets, priorities, and timelines for each function.

- Lead, supervise, and evaluate the performance of marketing team members and specialists.

- Manage workloads, delegate responsibilities, set priorities, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

- Establish standardized workflows, processes, and reporting systems to improve departmental efficiency.

- Coordinate with executive leadership and other departments to align marketing initiatives with sales, product launches, and overall business priorities.



2. E-commerce & Marketplace Management

- Lead and oversee the performance of eBay and Walmart marketplace accounts, working closely with the E-commerce Account Specialists.

- Ensure effective marketplace strategies for product listings, promotions, pricing coordination, visibility, conversion, and sales growth.

- Monitor marketplace performance, product rankings, traffic, conversion rates, and revenue.

- Collaborate with the team on product launches, listing optimization, merchandising, and marketplace-specific campaigns.

- Coordinate with supply chain, inventory, and operations teams to support product availability and promotional planning.

- Identify opportunities to improve marketplace performance and expand the company's online sales channels.



3. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising

- Supervise the Digital Marketing Specialist and oversee the execution of digital marketing campaigns.

- Lead marketing initiatives across Meta Ads and other relevant digital advertising channels.

- Monitor advertising budgets, campaign performance, return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and conversion rates.

- Ensure campaigns are properly planned, tested, optimized, and aligned with business objectives.

- Oversee audience targeting, retargeting, campaign testing, and performance optimization.

- Use analytics and reporting tools to identify trends, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and recommend improvements.



 4. Social Media & Content Marketing

- Oversee social media strategy, content planning, publishing schedules, and audience engagement across relevant platforms.

- Guide the Social Media Specialist in creating content that supports brand awareness, product promotion, and customer engagement.

- Ensure consistency in brand messaging, visual identity, tone, and marketing communications.

- Coordinate content calendars, campaign assets, product announcements, and promotional activities.

- Monitor social media performance, audience growth, engagement rates, and referral traffic.

- Ensure social media initiatives support the broader marketing and e-commerce strategies.



5. Influencer & Partnership Marketing

- Lead the overall influencer marketing strategy, including creator identification, outreach, collaboration planning, and campaign execution.

- Oversee influencer partnerships, product seeding, sponsored content, affiliate initiatives, and brand collaborations.

- Establish campaign objectives, deliverables, budgets, and performance indicators.

- Monitor influencer campaign results, including reach, engagement, referral traffic, conversions, and revenue where measurable.

- Build and maintain relationships with influencers, content creators, and strategic marketing partners.



6. Shopify & Website Marketing

- Oversee Shopify-related marketing initiatives in coordination with the responsible team members.

- Ensure the website supports marketing campaigns, product launches, promotions, and customer acquisition goals.

- Monitor website traffic, conversion rates, customer behavior, and sales performance.

- Coordinate website content updates, landing pages, promotional banners, product merchandising, and conversion optimization.

- Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey, user experience, and online store performance.

- Collaborate with relevant teams on SEO,
 marketing, and customer retention initiatives, as applicable.



7. Events & Brand Activations

- Plan, coordinate, and oversee marketing events, trade shows, industry exhibitions, product showcases, and brand activations.

- Manage event objectives, budgets, timelines, logistics, promotional materials, and team assignments.

- Coordinate with internal departments, event organizers, vendors, influencers, and external partners.

- Ensure events support brand awareness, lead generation, partnerships, customer engagement, and sales opportunities.

- Evaluate event performance and prepare post-event reports with recommendations for future activities.



 8. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Establish and monitor KPIs for the marketing department and its individual functions.

- Consolidate reports covering marketplace sales, advertising performance, website conversions, social media engagement, influencer campaigns, and event results.

- Analyze marketing data to identify opportunities, challenges, and areas for improvement.

- Present regular performance updates, insights, and recommendations to executive leadership.

- Ensure marketing activities are evaluated based on measurable business outcomes, not just completed tasks.

- Recommend adjustments to strategies, budgets, and resource allocation based on performance data.



9. Cross-Functional Coordination

- Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, Product, and executive leadership to align marketing activities with company goals.

- Coordinate promotional calendars, product launches, inventory availability, campaign requirements, and budget approvals.

- Ensure clear communication, accountability, and timely execution across marketing functions.

- Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to departmental processes and collaboration.



Qualifications & Requirements



- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred.

- At least 5 years of relevant marketing experience, including experience managing marketing campaigns and leading people or teams.

- Proven experience overseeing multiple marketing functions, preferably in e-commerce, retail, consumer products, or a similar business environment.

- Experience with eBay and Walmart marketplace operations or marketplace account management.

- Strong understanding of digital marketing, paid advertising, Meta Ads, social media management, influencer marketing, and content strategy.

- Working knowledge of Shopify and e-commerce website performance optimization.

- Experience planning and managing marketing events, partnerships, or brand activations.

- Proficiency in marketing analytics, KPI tracking, budget management, and performance reporting.

- Strong leadership, project management, communication, and decision-making skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, lead remote teams, and ensure accountability across different marketing functions.

- Data-driven mindset with a strong focus on business results, continuous improvement, and return on investment.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be evaluated based on agreed targets, including:



- Marketing-attributed revenue growth and contribution to overall sales.

- E-commerce marketplace sales, conversion rates, and account performance.

- Paid advertising efficiency, ROAS, and customer acquisition cost.

- Website traffic, conversion rates, and Shopify store performance.

- Social media growth, engagement, and referral traffic.

- Influencer campaign performance and measurable business outcomes.

- Event execution, budget adherence, and lead or partnership generation.

- Achievement of marketing campaign deadlines, budgets, and objectives.

- Team productivity, quality of deliverables, and achievement of individual KPIs.

- Accuracy and timeliness of reporting and cross-department coordination.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a strategic marketing leader who understands how different marketing functions work together to drive business growth. They can guide specialists, establish clear priorities, manage budgets, interpret performance data, and take ownership of the department's overall results.



This person should be comfortable managing both the strategic direction and operational execution of marketing activities while building a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented team.

Amazon Supervisor



Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home  

Department: Amazon Operations  

Reports To: Amazon Manager



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Supervisor to oversee daily Amazon operations and ensure the team consistently delivers accurate, efficient, and high-quality work.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central, product listing management, FBA inventory, account health, sales performance, and advertising metrics. This person will supervise daily workflows, monitor team performance, resolve operational issues, and coordinate with other departments to keep Amazon operations running smoothly.



You will work closely with the Amazon Manager to execute business strategies, improve operational efficiency, and support the company's continued growth in the Amazon marketplace.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Store & Listing Management

- Supervise the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Amazon product listings.

- Ensure product titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, A+ content, pricing, and variations are accurate and updated.

- Monitor listing quality, keyword optimization, organic rankings, and catalog performance.

- Identify and resolve listing errors, suppressed listings, and catalog issues.

- Ensure listing updates and optimization tasks are completed accurately and on time.



2. Sales & Performance Monitoring

- Monitor daily and weekly sales, traffic, conversion rates, and overall store performance.

- Track sales performance against targets and identify underperforming products.

- Coordinate the implementation of approved promotions, deals, coupons, and pricing updates.

- Analyze sales trends and recommend opportunities to improve product visibility and conversions.

- Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable insights to the Amazon Manager.



3. Inventory & FBA Operations

- Monitor FBA inventory levels, stock availability, and inventory health.

- Coordinate with Supply Chain and inventory planning teams on replenishment requirements.

- Identify potential stockouts, excess inventory, aged inventory, and stranded inventory.

- Follow up on inventory-related concerns and ensure timely resolution.

- Help maintain healthy inventory levels and product availability across Amazon marketplaces.



4. Amazon Account Health & Compliance

- Monitor Account Health, policy notifications, listing suppressions, and other account-related issues.

- Ensure compliance with Amazon policies, marketplace requirements, and internal procedures.

- Coordinate the resolution of account performance issues, listing violations, and customer-related concerns.

- Manage follow-ups on cases submitted to Amazon Seller Support.

- Escalate critical account risks, policy violations, and potential suspensions to the Amazon Manager.



5. Advertising & Campaign Monitoring

- Monitor Amazon PPC campaigns and advertising performance in coordination with the responsible team.

- Review advertising metrics, including ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, and ad-driven sales.

- Track campaign budgets, keyword performance, and opportunities for optimization.

- Coordinate approved campaign adjustments and promotional activities.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and communicate recommendations to the Amazon Manager.



6. Team Supervision & Workflow Management

- Supervise daily team activities, task assignments, priorities, and deadlines.

- Monitor individual productivity, work quality, and adherence to established procedures.

- Review completed tasks to ensure accuracy and consistency.

- Provide guidance, coaching, and constructive feedback to team members.

- Follow up on pending tasks and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

- Identify recurring operational problems and recommend process improvements.

- Promote accountability, clear communication, and continuous improvement within the team.



7. Reporting & Cross-Department Coordination

- Prepare and maintain regular reports, trackers, and documentation related to Amazon operations.

- Coordinate with Supply Chain, Product Development, Marketing, and other relevant departments.

- Communicate operational concerns, delays, and performance trends to the Amazon Manager.

- Track action items and ensure timely follow-up across departments.

- Recommend improvements to workflows, reporting, and day-to-day operations.



Qualifications & Requirements



- Proven experience in Amazon Seller Central and e-commerce operations.

- Previous experience in a supervisory, team lead, or operations leadership role 

- Strong understanding of Amazon product listing management, catalog maintenance, and listing optimization.

- Experience with FBA inventory management, replenishment coordination, and inventory health monitoring.

- Familiarity with Amazon Account Health, policy compliance, and Seller Support cases.

- Knowledge of Amazon PPC advertising and metrics such as ACOS, ROAS, and TACOS.

- Ability to analyze sales reports, identify performance trends, and recommend operational improvements.

- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and supervise team deliverables.

- Proficiency in spreadsheets, reporting tools, and e-commerce management systems.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while coordinating with a distributed team.



 What We’re Looking For



- A hands-on leader who can manage daily operations while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

- Someone who takes ownership of tasks, follows through on commitments, and holds the team accountable.

- A proactive problem-solver who can identify issues before they become major operational concerns.

- A detail-oriented individual who is comfortable working with data, reports, and performance metrics.

- A collaborative team player who can coordinate effectively with management and other departments.



 How to Apply



If you have experience in Amazon operations and enjoy leading a team, improving processes, and supporting e-commerce growth, we would love to hear from you.



Please submit your updated resume highlighting your relevant Amazon experience, leadership responsibilities, and key accomplishments.

# REMOTE AFFILIATE SALES REPRESENTATIVE | PEPTIDE SALES



**$1 Weekly Base Pay | 15% Uncapped Commission | Flexible Schedule**



Amino 365 is looking for motivated, outgoing, and creative individuals to find new customers and generate sales through cold outreach.



This is a remote, performance-based sales opportunity. You can manage your own schedule, but you must be willing to consistently contact new people, create content, participate in online communities, and follow up with potential customers.



## PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This position provides:



- **Weekly base payment: $1**

- **Sales commission: 15% of eligible sales**

- **Commission limit: No predetermined cap**

- **Hourly pay: None**

- **Guaranteed commission income: None**

- **Warm leads provided: None**



The majority of your earnings will come from the sales you personally generate.



Amino 365 does not guarantee customers, leads, sales, commissions, or a minimum level of income. If you want a traditional fixed salary or hourly position, this opportunity will not be the right fit.



## WHAT ARE PEPTIDES?



Peptides are short chains of amino 
. Amino 
 are the small building blocks that make up proteins.



Different peptide compounds are studied across many areas, including metabolic science, performance science, tissue and recovery research, cellular and longevity science, skincare science, neuroscience, and other specialized fields.



Amino 365 offers a broad selection of peptide compounds and related products through its online store.



You do not need to be a scientist. However, you must be willing to learn the basic product categories, review the information provided by Amino 365, and clearly explain the company and its product selection to potential customers.



## THIS IS A COLD-OUTREACH POSITION



Amino 365 does not provide a list of customers waiting to purchase.



You are responsible for finding potential customers, starting conversations, introducing them to Amino 365, and following up until they purchase.



Cold outreach means contacting or engaging with people who have not previously spoken with you or Amino 365. You must be proactive and comfortable creating your own sales opportunities.



Your outreach may include:



- Commenting on relevant TikTok videos

- Creating and publishing TikTok posts or videos

- Commenting on relevant Instagram posts and Reels

- Creating Instagram posts, Stories, and Reels

- Sending personalized Instagram and TikTok direct messages

- Participating in relevant Reddit communities

- Creating helpful Reddit posts and comments

- Responding to people already discussing peptides or related subjects

- Participating in relevant
 groups

- Joining relevant 
 servers and online communities

- Contacting fitness, wellness, beauty, and peptide content creators

- Connecting with personal trainers, coaches, and community leaders

- Reaching out through
 and other social platforms

- Using your personal network to generate introductions

- Testing new outreach ideas and determining what produces sales



Representatives should be creative. You should not wait for someone to give you a daily list of people to contact.



Look for relevant conversations, pages, creators, videos, posts, and communities where potential customers are already active. Find natural opportunities to start conversations and introduce Amino 365.



Outreach should be relevant, personalized, and professional. Simply sending the same random message to thousands of unrelated people is unlikely to produce strong results.



## BEST CUSTOMER MARKETS



The strongest potential customers are generally people who are already familiar with peptides or interested in learning more about peptide products.



Potential markets include:



- Existing peptide customers

- Peptide education and information communities

- Fitness and bodybuilding communities

- Athletic performance communities

- Weight-management and metabolic-health communities

- Biohacking and longevity communities

- Recovery, mobility, and wellness communities

Our average customer order is approximately **$250**:



**$250 Average Order × 15% Commission = $37.50 Commission**

## WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities include:

## WHO SHOULD APPLY?

s and meet with our team live

Common choices are 9:00 to 11:00 AM ET (evening in Manila) or 3:00 to 5:00 PM ET (early morning in Manila). The rest of your hours are on your own schedule as long as deadlines are met.



Schedule and pay:

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

1. Confirmation that this will be your only full-time job

4. A short description of your month-end reconciliation process

, calendars, spreadsheets, and digital communication tools.

title: Remote Part-Time Bookkeeper / Financial Administrator
description:
We are a growing handyman, remodeling, and home-services company looking for a part-time remote bookkeeper/financial administrator to help us build a more organized and scalable financial system.



This is a low-hour, flexible position and would be ideal for an experienced bookkeeper who already works with other clients. Hours will fluctuate throughout the month, with heavier workloads around month-end/month-start and lighter workloads during other weeks.



Expected workload: Approximately 15–25 hours per month after onboarding. The initial setup/cleanup period may require additional hours.



Responsibilities will include bookkeeping and transaction categorization, bank and credit-card reconciliation, accounts receivable and payable tracking, receipt and vendor documentation, subcontractor/W-9 tracking, job costing, estimated-vs.-actual project analysis, payroll/labor-cost review, monthly financial reporting, and identifying financial discrepancies or areas where the company may be losing margin.



A major focus of this position will be job profitability. We want to understand the true labor, material, subcontractor, and miscellaneous costs associated with individual projects so that we can improve estimating and pricing as the company grows.

The ideal candidate has experience with quickbooks, construction, remodeling, field-service, or trades-based businesses. Experience with Jobber is a plus.



Our goal is to create a system where the bookkeeper can independently access and organize the majority of the information needed without requiring constant communication with the owner. Questions and exceptions will generally be consolidated for a short weekly review rather than handled through daily interruptions.



This role has the potential to grow as the company continues to expand, but we specifically need someone who is comfortable with relatively low and fluctuating hours at the beginning.

 outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networking.

Industry experience is a strict requirement. General B2B sales, SaaS sales, real estate sales, insurance sales, retail sales, and other sales backgrounds without direct staffing or recruitment industry sales experience do not meet the minimum qualifications.



Relevant Business Development & Sales Backgrounds

New Business Development

* Staffing Business Development

* Recruitment Agency Sales

* New Client Acquisition

* Outbound Prospecting and Lead Generation

* Recruitment Service Sales



Client Relations & Account Growth

* Staffing Account Management

* Client Relationship Development

* Existing Account Expansion

* Key Account Management

* Recruitment Partnership Development



Specialized Recruitment Markets

* Technology and IT Staffing

* Healthcare and Medical Staffing

* Finance and Accounting Recruitment

* Engineering and Manufacturing Staffing

* Professional and Executive Search

* Industrial, Logistics, and Commercial Staffing



Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed. We are primarily interested in the depth of your staffing and recruitment sales experience, your familiarity with the US market, and your ability to contribute to client acquisition and business growth.



What We Value

* Industry knowledge: A practical understanding of how staffing and recruitment firms acquire clients, generate job orders, and develop profitable business relationships.

* Commercial judgment: The ability to identify genuine business opportunities, qualify prospective clients, and prioritize accounts with meaningful growth potential.

* Prospecting expertise: Confidence in reaching decision makers, initiating commercial conversations, and developing relationships with prospective clients.

* Professional communication: Clear and credible conversations with hiring leaders, business owners, and recruitment decision makers.

* Ownership and consistency: Disciplined pipeline management, reliable follow through, and accountability for sales activity and business development results.

Compensation

Compensation will vary based on the hiring organization, position, relevant staffing and recruitment sales experience, US market exposure, and demonstrated commercial performance. Depending on the opportunity, compensation may include a fixed base salary, performance incentives, commissions, or a combination of these components. Specific compensation details will be discussed when a suitable opportunity becomes available.



Employment Structure

Alderstone Partners connects experienced professionals with staffing and recruitment firms for potential direct employment. When a suitable opportunity becomes available, qualified professionals may be contacted to discuss the position, hiring organization, compensation structure, and employment requirements before proceeding.

Successful candidates will be employed directly by the hiring organization, not Alderstone Partners.

This posting is intended to identify and engage qualified professionals for Alderstone Partners' growing talent network. title: Recruitment Professionals | US Staffing & Recruitment Industry
description:
Recruitment Professionals | US Staffing & Recruitment Industry

Full-time · Fully Remote · Based in the Philippines · Potential Direct Hire Opportunities with US Staffing & Recruitment Firms



IMPORTANT: Direct recruitment experience supporting the US market is mandatory. Applicants whose recruitment experience is exclusively within the Philippine domestic market or other international markets without US recruitment exposure will not be considered.



COMPLETE YOUR PROFILE HERE: 



About the Opportunity

Alderstone Partners is expanding its network of experienced Recruitment Professionals based in the Philippines for potential direct hire opportunities with staffing agencies, recruitment firms, and executive search organizations serving the US market.



We're connecting with professionals who have demonstrated experience sourcing, screening, engaging, and managing candidates for US based positions across various industries and recruitment specializations.



This posting is part of our ongoing talent network development and is not tied to a single confirmed vacancy. Our goal is to identify and assess qualified professionals whose experience may align with the future hiring requirements of our partner firms.



Opportunities may include Talent Sourcers, Recruitment Specialists, US Recruiters, Technical Recruiters, Healthcare Recruiters, Senior Recruiters, Recruitment Team Leads, Recruitment Managers, and other related recruitment positions.



We are particularly interested in professionals who understand the US recruitment process, can navigate competitive talent markets, and have experience supporting recruitment delivery for staffing agencies, recruitment firms, or other organizations serving US clients.

What You May Be Responsible For

Responsibilities will vary depending on the hiring organization, recruitment specialization, and client requirements.

- Manage full cycle recruitment activities, from candidate sourcing and initial screening through interview coordination, offer management, and placement support.

- Source and identify qualified candidates for US based positions using job boards, professional networks, resume databases, referrals, and other recruitment channels.

- Conduct candidate screening calls to assess professional experience, technical qualifications, employment preferences, compensation expectations, and availability.

- Evaluate candidate qualifications against job requirements, hiring criteria, and client expectations.

- Develop and execute sourcing strategies for active requisitions across relevant industries and specialized positions.

- Prepare accurate candidate profiles, screening summaries, and professional recommendations for client or hiring manager review.

- Coordinate candidate submissions, interview schedules, feedback collection, and hiring process updates.

- Build and maintain relationships with active and passive candidates to support current and future recruitment requirements.

- Collaborate with account managers, recruitment leaders, hiring managers, and client stakeholders to clarify job requirements and recruitment priorities.

- Maintain accurate candidate records, recruitment activities, and pipeline updates using applicant tracking systems and recruitment platforms.

- Manage multiple requisitions while maintaining consistent candidate engagement, follow through, and recruitment quality.

- Monitor recruitment performance through relevant measures such as qualified submissions, interviews, offers, placements, and candidate conversion rates.

- Support candidate negotiations, offer discussions, and onboarding coordination where applicable.

What We Are Looking For

- Direct professional experience recruiting for positions within the US market.

- Experience working in staffing agencies, recruitment firms, executive search organizations, recruitment process outsourcing environments, or comparable US focused recruitment operations.

- Demonstrated experience sourcing, screening, and evaluating candidates against specific job requirements.

- Practical understanding of US recruitment practices, candidate engagement, hiring processes, and market expectations.

- Experience using recruitment platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Dice, CareerBuilder, ZipRecruiter, or other relevant sourcing channels.

- Familiarity with applicant tracking systems such as Bullhorn, CEIPAL, JobDiva, Manatal, Recruit CRM, or similar platforms.

- Ability to assess candidate qualifications, communicate job opportunities, and manage professional conversations with US based candidates.

- Experience coordinating candidate submissions, interviews, client feedback, and recruitment processes.

- Strong written and spoken English, with confidence communicating directly with US candidates and recruitment stakeholders.

- Ability to manage recruitment priorities, maintain organized candidate pipelines, and demonstrate accountability for recruitment outcomes.

- Attention to detail when reviewing resumes, assessing qualifications, documenting candidate information, and managing submissions.

- Availability to support US business hours depending on the hiring organization's requirements.

US recruitment experience is a strict requirement. Applicants with experience exclusively in Philippine domestic recruitment, local HR administration, general administrative support, or nonrecruitment positions without direct US recruitment experience do not meet the minimum qualifications.

Relevant Recruitment Backgrounds

We welcome professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas.

Recruitment Delivery & Candidate Management

- Full Cycle Recruitment

- Candidate Sourcing & Talent Research

- Resume Screening & Qualification

- Candidate Engagement & Relationship Management

- Interview Coordination & Offer Management

- Recruitment Pipeline Management

- High Volume Recruitment

- Specialized & Hard to Fill Recruitment

Recruitment Specializations

- Technology & IT Recruitment

- Healthcare & Medical Recruitment

- Finance & Accounting Recruitment

- Engineering & Manufacturing Recruitment

- Construction & Skilled Trades Recruitment

- Professional & Executive Search

- Industrial, Logistics & Commercial Staffing

- Corporate & Administrative Recruitment

Recruitment Operations & Leadership

- Recruitment Team Leadership

- Recruitment Delivery Management

- Recruitment Process Improvement

- Recruitment Performance & KPI Management

- Client & Hiring Manager Coordination

- Recruitment Training & Mentorship

- Talent Mapping & Workforce Research

- Recruitment Strategy & Market Intelligence

Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed. We are primarily interested in the depth of your US recruitment experience, your industry specialization, your ability to identify and engage qualified candidates, and your contribution to successful recruitment outcomes.

What We Value

- Recruitment expertise: A practical understanding of US hiring practices, candidate markets, recruitment workflows, and the qualifications required across relevant industries.

- Candidate assessment: The ability to evaluate professional backgrounds, identify strong matches, and present qualified candidates based on specific hiring requirements.

- Sourcing capabilities: Confidence in identifying active and passive candidates, navigating recruitment platforms, and developing effective sourcing strategies.

- Professional communication: Clear and credible conversations with candidates, hiring managers, account managers, and recruitment stakeholders.

- Ownership and consistency: Disciplined pipeline management, reliable follow through, and accountability for recruitment activities and delivery outcomes.

- Relationship development: The ability to establish trust, maintain candidate engagement, and develop professional relationships that support long term recruitment success.

- Quality and judgment: The ability to prioritize candidate suitability, understand client expectations, and balance recruitment efficiency with quality.

Compensation

Compensation will vary based on the hiring organization, position, relevant US recruitment experience, industry specialization, and demonstrated recruitment performance.



Depending on the opportunity, compensation may include a fixed base salary, performance incentives, placement bonuses, commissions, or a combination of these components.



Specific compensation details will be discussed when a suitable opportunity becomes available.

Employment Structure

Alderstone Partners connects experienced recruitment professionals with staffing and recruitment firms for potential direct employment.



When a suitable opportunity becomes available, qualified professionals may be contacted to discuss the position, hiring organization, compensation structure, and employment requirements before proceeding.



Successful candidates will be employed directly by the hiring organization, not Alderstone Partners.



Alderstone Partners facilitates candidate assessment, professional introductions, and hiring coordination. The hiring organization retains responsibility for its recruitment decisions and employment arrangements.

Important Information About Your Application

This posting is intended to identify and engage qualified professionals for Alderstone Partners' growing talent network. It does not represent an immediate opening or guarantee an interview, employment offer, or placement.



Applications will be reviewed based on relevant US recruitment experience, professional background, industry specialization, recruitment capabilities, and potential alignment with future client requirements.



Qualified candidates may be contacted as suitable opportunities become available. Any introduction to a prospective hiring organization will be discussed with the candidate beforehand.



If you have direct US recruitment experience and are open to exploring meaningful career opportunities with staffing and recruitment firms, we welcome you to join the Alderstone Network and share more about your professional background.

/ month, depending on experience



About the Role



We're hired by sign companies nationwide to research local government sign regulations — how many signs a property is allowed, size limits, placement restrictions, permit requirements, and more. You'll dig into municipal codes and zoning rules, then summarize your findings on our forms (Excel or PDF) so our clients can design signage and apply for permits with confidence.



This is high-volume, detail-oriented, independent research work — a great fit if you enjoy figuring out how local regulations actually work, like clear targets, and can work through a queue efficiently without letting quality slip.

• Detail-oriented and highly organized

• Comfortable reading and interpreting regulatory/technical documents

• Excellent written and spoken English; confident making calls to US government offices

• Proficient in Excel, Word, and Adobe PDF editor

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace for calls, PC with Microsoft Office; backup power/internet preferred

• Available full-time during 9 am–6 pm ET 

• Takes ownership, works independently, and can hit a monthly quota consistently



Ideal Background

Strong fit for candidates with 3+ years in US permitting, title or lien research, paralegal/legal research, real estate, or BPO back-office roles involving document review for US clients. Prior exposure to US municipal codes or zoning is a plus.

• Fixed monthly salary in USD for meeting a minimum volume of completed code checks. Pay depends on prior experience.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

*Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment



Requirements:

-3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

-Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

-Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

-Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

-Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

-Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for email & mobile marketing

-Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

-Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

-A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

-Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

-Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

-Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

-Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

-Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

title: Cold-Calling Appointment Setter, US Hours (B2B SaaS, long-term)
description:
Please read this first. The shift is 12 noon to 8pm US Eastern. That is 1am to 9am in the Philippines. If that doesn't work, this isn't the job. If you've worked US hours before, we want to hear from you.



We're CustomGPT.ai, a Boston company. We build an AI assistant for membership associations (bar associations, medical societies, trade groups). We're adding a caller to our team.



THE JOB

- Call CEOs and executive directors of associations. Book a 30-minute intro with our platform expert.

- High volume:
dials a day on a prepared list through our dialer. You don't build lists.

- These are first calls to strangers. Not callbacks, not reminders, not warm leads.

- Log every call in our CRM. Get past gatekeepers honestly. No tricks.

- Same day: send the invite and a short recap.

- A weekly review of your numbers and recorded calls.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

- Made 100+ cold dials a day in a real job and can prove it. If your past roles were 30-50 dials a day, this will feel very different.

- Cold-called senior decision makers (CEOs, executive directors, owners, VPs). You can name the exact titles and what you sold.

- Have 12+ months of outbound B2B phone work with one employer or client.

- Know your own numbers and can give a reference.

- Sound like a person on the phone, not someone reading.

- Have worked nights before, with a headset, a quiet room and backup internet.



NOT A FIT

- Appointment-reminder, service-scheduling or callback calling as your main phone work (for example car dealership service lines, clinics, utilities)

-
-only or chat-only experience

- Consumer sales as your whole background

- Agencies or teams. We hire one person

- Anyone who uses a script reader, a voice changer or an AI voice



PAY AND PROCESS

- $10-$14 an hour, plus $75 for each qualified meeting that takes place. Paid weekly.

- Rate review every 3 months, up to $15/hr.

- Every hour of training and trial is paid.

- How we hire: (1) answer the 6 questions and record the voice sample, (2) the best few do a paid 2-day cold-calling test on a real list, (3) a 15-minute video call and a reference check, (4) a paid one-week trial, then a contract.

- We check what you tell us. We record the test calls, with your clear yes first.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with: "I read the hours: 1am-9am PH."

2. Answer the 6 questions below.

3. Record the voice sample below and paste the link. One take, no editing.



THE 6 QUESTIONS

1. Last outbound phone job: employer, what they sold, the exact job titles you called most, start and end dates (month and year), why it ended.

2. Your numbers, best three months: dials per day, live conversations per day, meetings booked per month, and how many took place. How did the company count a meeting?

3. Cold or warm? Was your first call to a stranger who had never heard of the company? Or were you calling existing customers, inbound leads or booked appointments? Where did the list come from?

4. Night shift: have you worked US hours before? How long? How do you manage sleep and your setup? What headset and backup internet do you have?

5. Who can we contact to confirm? Name, title, company, and how they would describe your results.

6. Your rate within $10-$14/hr, and why.



THE VOICE SAMPLE

Record one voice message, 60 to 90 seconds. One take. No editing, no music, no reading from a script. Use a headset or your phone close to your mouth, in a quiet room. Record it on 
 and paste the link.

The scene: you are cold-calling Jordan Blake, Executive Director of a professional association. A gatekeeper answers first and asks "What's this regarding?"

1. Get past the gatekeeper, honestly.

2. Pitch Jordan a 30-minute intro meeting about an AI assistant that answers members' questions from the association's own content.

3. Handle one objection: "We already have a website search."

4. Close on a specific day and time.

Play both sides, or leave silent pauses where they would reply. Your choice. Do not read.
