You notice gaps in how the business runs and bring a fix, like a guest question that keeps getting answered from scratch or a report someone rebuilds by hand every week. When you see work being done manually, you look for a way to automate it and you're willing to build it yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Guest communication

• Reply to guest messages in Guesty and Airbnb before, during and after each stay. Slow or missed replies are the biggest driver of bad reviews for us, so speed matters.

• Handle check-in and access issues, Wi-Fi, house rules, booking changes, cancellations, and early check-in, late checkout, pet and parking requests.

• Calm down unhappy guests and fix the problem before it becomes a bad review, including refunds within our guidelines.

• Answer questions about our Damage Protection Program and other fees, and apply our waiver policy.

• Ask guests who had a great stay to leave a review.



Reviews and Airbnb

• Track review scores at the unit level and flag units that are slipping.

• Respond to reviews and work with Airbnb Support on removal requests for reviews that break Airbnb policy.

• Handle Resolution Center cases and damage claims.



Operations

• Dispatch and follow up on cleaning and maintenance issues with our local teams until they're closed.

• Keep listings, check-in guides and unit details (door codes, Wi-Fi, instructions) accurate.

• Keep our Notion workspace current: tasks, maintenance tracker, SOPs.

• Pull daily and weekly reports on guest issues, reviews and unit performance.



AI and agentic workflows

• Use Claude and ChatGPT every day to draft guest replies, summarize long threads, analyze review and reservation data in Google Sheets, and write SOPs.

• Build and maintain the knowledge our AI tools work from: property details, house rules, policies, prompt libraries, Claude Projects and custom GPTs.

• Help build and run agentic workflows in Claude and ChatGPT (connectors, MCP, agents) for routine steps like inbox triage, flagging at-risk stays, logging issues to Notion and sending daily reports.

• Spot repetitive work, propose how to automate it, and document what you build so the rest of the team can use it.

• Review AI output before it reaches a guest. Protect guest data and logins, and never paste passwords or API keys into AI tools.



TOOLS WE USE

Airbnb, VRBO, Guesty, HostOp (our in-house platform), Stripe, PriceLabs, Notion, Monday.com, Google Workspace, Claude, ChatGPT.



You don't need every one on day one. You do need to have worked inside a PMS (Guesty preferred) and be comfortable in Google Sheets and Notion.



MUST HAVE

• 3+ years in short-term rental guest communication or operations, with Airbnb as a main channel

• A self-starter who spots gaps and manual work and fixes or automates them without being asked

• Daily use of Claude and ChatGPT in real work, with examples you can show

• Hands-on experience with at least one agentic or automation setup: Claude Code, Claude with connectors or MCP, custom GPTs with actions, Make or Zapier with AI steps, or an AI agent you've built or run

• Excellent written English that reads warm and natural, not scripted

• Good judgment on when to fix, when to refund and when to escalate

• Comfortable in Google Sheets: filters, formulas, pivot tables

• Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

• Available full time on U.S. Eastern hours (Philippine night shift)



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience at Airbnb Support or with a property manager running 100+ units

• PriceLabs or Stripe experience

• Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks and JSON

• Experience writing SOPs and training other VAs



WHAT WE OFFER

• Full-time, long-term role

• Team bonuses tied to portfolio review scores

• Raises based on performance reviews

• A team that is building AI into every part of its operations



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Your application must include all of the following:



1. Start your message with "LUXORA AI" so we know you read the full post.

2. Your resume (PDF).

3. A 3 to 5 minute screen-share video (Loom, or unlisted YouTube or Google Drive) walking us through one real AI workflow you use or built in Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool. Show it working and explain what it saves you.

4. Your reply to the guest message below, plus 2 to 3 lines on what you'd do behind the scenes. Use AI the way you normally would, and include the share link to the chat or the prompt you used.

   "Hi, the door code you sent isn't working. We've been outside for 25 minutes with two kids and it's 11pm. If we're not inside in 10 minutes I want a full refund."

5. In 3 to 5 sentences: one agentic workflow you would build in your first 30 days for a 280-unit Airbnb operation, and which tools you'd use.

6. In 3 to 5 sentences: a manual process you noticed in a past role and fixed or automated on your own initiative. What was it, what did you build, and what did it save?

7. A screenshot of your internet speed test.



Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA
description:
Position: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA (Commission Only)

Pay: $6 per lead I purchase + 5% profit share on every sold unit from your leads

Schedule: Flexible. Work your own hours. Paid on results, not time.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED. AVAILABLE TO START IMMEDIATELY.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I need someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently from day one.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and d
 whether a product is actually worth buying.



HOW YOU GET PAID 💰



There is no salary or hourly pay. Everything is commission based.



$6 per purchased lead: You earn $6 for every lead I actually buy inventory from. Submitting a lead does not earn the $6. It’s paid once I place an order from that lead.



5% profit share: You also get 5% of the net profit on units from your leads that sell. Net profit means sale price minus Amazon fees, product cost, shipping, prep, and any other direct costs. [Applies to the first purchase only / Applies to all reorders for X months.]



Payment schedule: All payments are made weekly. Each week you’re paid $6 for every lead I bought from that week, plus 5% of the net profit on any of your units that sold that week.



The more strong leads you find, the more you earn. There’s no cap.



TRIAL PERIOD



Before you’re hired, you’ll complete a short trial so I can see your sourcing skills firsthand.



You’ll get my sourcing spreadsheet, my ungated brand list, and the example competition chart

You’ll have [5] days to submit 3 to 5 leads that meet ALL the requirements below

I’ll review each lead the same way I review regular submissions

If I buy from any of your trial leads, you get paid the normal $6 per lead

If your leads consistently pass, you’re hired and move to the regular team



Trial leads should show your best work. Accuracy, source verification, and good judgment on quantity matter more than speed.



WEEKLY TARGET



Aim for at least 25 quality leads per week. VAs who consistently send leads I buy from will get priority on brand lists and first access to any future paid or higher-commission roles.



Quality matters more than volume. I’d rather get 5 strong leads than 20 bad ones. Leads that clearly break the requirements earn nothing, and repeatedly sending them will get you removed from the team.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be from a brand I’m already approved/ungated to sell

Make at least $2 profit per unit

Have at least 100 estimated sales per month

NOT be a generic brand

Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales (I’ll give you an example chart for the criteria)

Leave enough room for me to join the listing without crashing the price

Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE

Be in stock and available to buy

Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation

Include the correct source link

Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing

Not have already been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Don’t submit deals that only work when buying an unrealistic quantity.



Example: if a product only meets my requirements at 25 units, but the listing sells around 50 units a month and has 20 competing sellers, I’m not buying 25 units.



Look at monthly sales, number of sellers, competition, and minimum purchase quantity together. The deal has to make sense for my business, not just look good on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before you submit it.



A VA recently sent me a fake website that looked like a major retailer. I bought from it and my card information was stolen. That can’t happen again.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites

Scam websites

Copycat websites

Suspicious Shopify stores

Random websites with no established reputation

Sources you haven’t properly researched

A retailer/distributor different from the one you listed in the spreadsheet



If you’re unsure whether a source is legit, DON’T SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



Amazon Seller Central

Amazon FBA

Online Arbitrage

Product sourcing

Keepa

Stealth Seller (required, this is what we use) or SellerAmp SAS

Buy Box analysis

Sales rank / estimated monthly sales

Amazon fees

Profit calculations

Seller/competition analysis

Variation matching

Source verification

Checking whether Amazon is on the listing

Spotting dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition

Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?

Have you done Online Arbitrage before?

What sourcing tools have you used?

Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.

Do you know how to use Stealth Seller? If not, have you used SellerAmp?

How do you d
 whether a listing has too many sellers?

How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?

How do you d
 how many units of a product to recommend buying?

What’s the difference between profit and ROI?

Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find more profitable products? Explain your process.

Are you comfortable with commission-only pay and a trial period? How soon can you start?



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you’ve worked with before, with confidential client info removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link you think is worth researching for Online Arbitrage, and briefly explain why you picked it.



If you can’t answer these questions, please don’t apply.



I’m looking for someone who already knows what they’re doing, pays attention to detail, follows instructions, verifies sources, and can consistently find products I can actually buy and sell.

title: Sales & Marketing Manager (CRM & Community Outreach) – Remote
description:
Sales & Marketing Manager (CRM & Community Outreach) – Remote



Company: Boarding & Beyond – Dog Daycare, Boarding & Grooming

Location: Remote 

Schedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | U.S. Mountain Time

Compensation: $4,000 USD/Month (Base + Performance Bonuses)

Website: 



Are you already exceptional at sales, customer communication, CRM management, and building relationships? Do you consistently produce results, identify opportunities, and take initiative without needing constant direction?



We're hiring an experienced Sales & Marketing Manager to convert inquiries into paying customers, improve sales follow-up, build referral partnerships, and drive business growth.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT a technical digital marketing role. You don't need experience managing Google Ads,
 Ads, websites, or advanced CRM automations. Other specialists handle those responsibilities.



We want someone who excels at connecting with people, closing sales, managing customer relationships, and executing practical marketing and outreach strategies.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We're looking for an A player with proven skills, strong judgment, and a history of measurable results. 



We provide the tools, resources, and goals. You bring the expertise, initiative, and ability to execute.





About Boarding & Beyond:

Founded in 1996, Boarding & Beyond has spent 30 years making a difference in the lives of dogs and the families who love them. Located in Aurora, Colorado, USA, we provide dog daycare, boarding, and grooming services.  Our mission is simple: Change dogs' lives for the better while giving pet parents peace of mind. 



We believe exceptional businesses are built by exceptional people. Our culture values customer service, ownership, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.  We're looking for a highly capable professional who wants to make a meaningful contribution to our continued growth.



Your Mission: Generate More Paying Customers



Your primary responsibility will be to help Boarding & Beyond acquire new customers, convert more inquiries into bookings, and increase repeat business.



We already receive inquiries from dog owners interested in our services. Your first priority will be making sure those opportunities turn into paying customers.



Beyond sales conversion, you'll take ownership of customer follow-up, CRM execution, referral generation, local business outreach, and organic marketing initiatives.



You'll be responsible for executing proven strategies, identifying improvements, and producing measurable results.



Your Key Responsibilities



1. Sales & Lead Conversion — Your #1 Priority



- Personally call, text, and
 prospective customers to convert inquiries into bookings.

- Proactively follow up with leads who haven't booked.

- Build rapport, establish trust, handle objections, and close sales.

- Identify missed sales opportunities and recover potential customers.

- Improve sales scripts, follow-up strategies, and booking conversion rates.

- Track leads, sales activity, and conversion performance.

- Take ownership of ensuring qualified opportunities don't get overlooked.



We're looking for someone who is already confident, persuasive, and effective at selling over the phone.



2. CRM Management & Sales Optimization



You'll use GoHighLevel to manage leads, customer communication, follow-up, and sales opportunities.



- Keep CRM records organized, accurate, and actionable.

- Manage sales pipelines and ensure timely follow-up.

- Review recorded customer calls to identify missed sales opportunities and customer service issues.

- Recommend and implement improvements that increase conversions.

- Execute customer follow-up and reactivation campaigns.

- Identify inefficiencies and improve existing CRM processes.

- Monitor and report performance.



We want someone who understands how to use a CRM to generate revenue—not someone who simply enters data.



3. Community Outreach & Referral Partnerships



- Proactively contact veterinarians, apartment communities, pet stores, and other local businesses.

- Develop relationships that generate new customer referrals.

- Confidently make outbound calls, present partnership opportunities, and handle objections.

- Create consistent follow-up processes for potential partners.

- Develop and execute customer referral programs.

- Track which partnerships and campaigns generate paying customers.



You should already be comfortable initiating conversations, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities.



4. Customer Retention & Reactivation



- Reengage inactive customers and encourage repeat bookings.

- Execute targeted
 and SMS campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to increase customer retention.

- Encourage and track customer referrals.

- Improve communication throughout the customer experience.

- Measure campaign results and continuously improve performance.



5. Marketing & Online Community Engagement



- Promote Boarding & Beyond in relevant local
 groups and online communities.

- Identify opportunities to reach local dog owners.

- Create and schedule social media posts using photos and videos we provide.

- Encourage authentic customer reviews and monitor online reputation.

- Execute organic marketing campaigns that generate inquiries and bookings.

- Identify, test, and improve customer acquisition strategies.



Paid advertising, website development, and advanced technical CRM development are handled separately.



Your focus is execution that produces customers and revenue—not marketing activity for its own sake.





Who We're Looking For



We want an experienced, highly capable professional with a demonstrated history of success.



You Must Already Be Strong In:



Sales & Closing

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident, persuasive phone communication with U.S. customers.

- Strong lead follow-up and objection-handling skills.

- A demonstrated ability to convert inquiries into paying customers.

- The ability to independently manage sales conversations from initial contact through booking.



CRM & Customer Relationship Management

- Experience managing leads, pipelines, and follow-up using CRM software.

- Understanding of how to improve sales conversion through effective follow-up.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to recognize sales process problems and recommend practical solutions.



Marketing & Business Development

- Experience executing marketing or customer acquisition initiatives.

- Ability to research prospects, conduct outreach, and develop relationships.

- Understanding of referrals, retention, and customer engagement.

- Ability to measure performance and improve results.



Independent Execution & Ownership

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Ability to prioritize high-impact work without constant supervision.

- Initiative to identify and solve problems independently.

- A track record of reliably completing commitments.

- A genuine desire to improve performance and contribute ideas.





We care far more about demonstrated performance than degrees, certifications, or impressive-sounding job titles.



You don't need to know the pet care industry. But you should already be highly competent in the core sales, communication, CRM, and marketing skills this position requires.





How We Operate



We give our team clear goals, tools, and the opportunity to take ownership. In return, we expect professionalism, accountability, and excellent execution.



Our operating principles are:



- Customer First: Every interaction should create value and build trust.

- Results Over Activity: We measure outcomes, not how busy you are.

- Own the Outcome: Take initiative, solve problems, and follow through.

- Focus on What Matters: Prioritize the work that generates the greatest impact.

- Raise the Standard: Deliver excellent work and continuously improve.

- Move Fast: Execute, measure, learn, and improve.

- Zero Silent Failures: Communicate problems early and bring a recovery plan.

- No Proof = Not Done: Use Asana to document commitments, deadlines, completed work, and results.

- Build Better Systems: Improve processes instead of repeatedly working around problems.



We don't believe great people need to be micromanaged. We believe they need clear expectations, the right tools, and the opportunity to perform.



How Success Is Measured



You'll have a written performance scorecard with clearly defined goals.



Success includes:



- Higher percentages of qualified inquiries converted into paying customers.

- More customers generated through follow-up and reactivation.

- More paying customers from referrals and local partnerships.

- Improved customer retention and repeat bookings.

- Better customer service and sales call quality.

- Accurate CRM management and consistent follow-through.

- Successful execution of marketing initiatives that generate measurable business results.



Your results—not simply your activity—will determine your performance.



Compensation: Exceptional Results Deserve Exceptional Rewards



We believe talented people who create meaningful business results should have the opportunity to earn more.



Monthly Compensation (USD)

- Guaranteed Base Salary: $1,000/month

- On-Target Earnings: $3,000/month total

- Exceptional Performance: Up to $4,000/month total



Performance bonuses are based on agreed-upon, measurable business results. Specific goals, bonus calculations, and eligibility will be established in a written performance scorecard. Bonus earnings are not guaranteed.



Produce more value. Earn more.





How to Apply  

Please submit:  

-Your current resume.  

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.  



We care more about demonstrated performance, initiative, and results than degrees or certifications.

s, LinkedIn, and phone calls, and schedule qualified appointments for the business owner. You will be responsible for managing daily outreach activities, following up with interested prospects, and keeping the CRM updated.

SHIFT

 outreach, or sales development.

 verification and deliverability best practices.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Real Estate Data Manager (YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH)
description:
* YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH *

We're a US-based virtual real estate company looking for a detail-oriented Data Manager to run our daily lead pipeline. Every morning you'll pull fresh distress lists from county sources, scrub the data, run skip tracing and phone verification, then import clean, dial-ready leads into our CRM before our acquisitions team starts calling.



The work is consistent, structured, and rewards accuracy. If you're the kind of person who notices a misspelled column header and fixes it without being asked — keep reading.



This is a long-term role. We want someone who will own this pipeline for years, not weeks.





Schedule

- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Days: Monday through Friday

- Time zone: 9am-6pm (CST)

- Deadline: All daily lists must be live in our CRM daily.



Pay

- $4–6 USD/hour depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly via Payoneer or PayPal

- Performance bonus for clean data quality and on-time delivery

- Raise review at 90 days



What You'll Do Every Day:

1. Pull distress lists from county government portals: probate, auction, tax delinquent, pre-foreclosure, and auction.

2. Scrub the data in Google Sheets — dedupe by APN, standardize addresses to USPS format, remove vacant land, cross-check against our CRM.

3. Organize each list into our standard 14-column upload format

4. Run the cleaned list through BatchLeads for skip tracing

5. Verify every phone number through Trestle (activity score, line type, connection status)

6. Reorder phones so the highest-scored number lands in Phone 1

7. Import the final file into FreedomSoft with the correct campaign tag and pipeline stage

8. Log every step in our Master Tracker (raw count, scrubbed count, hit rate, etc.)



A full Standard Operating Procedure with screenshots and a worked example will be provided. You will not be figuring this out from scratch.



Tools You'll Use:

- Google Sheets (heavy daily use — formulas, filters, dedupe, VLOOKUP)

- FreedomSoft (our CRM — we'll train you)

- XLeads (skip tracing)

- Trestle (phone verification)

- County government websites (varies by list type)

- Slack (daily check-ins and questions)



What We Need From You:

- Strong Google Sheets skills — you should be comfortable with formulas, filters, dedupe, and conditional formatting

- Sharp attention to detail — bad data costs us real money

- Comfortable navigating unfamiliar government websites and exporting CSVs

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace

- Good written English for daily Slack updates

- Available Mon–Fri without exception (this is a daily pipeline — one missed day backs up the whole team)

- Able to start As Soon As Possible



Bonus Points If You Have:

- Prior US real estate experience

- Experience with FreedomSoft, BatchLeads, PropStream, or any real estate CRM

- Background in data entry, list management, or data cleaning roles

- Skip tracing experience (Xleads, Skip Genie, IDI, TLO, etc.)

- Familiarity with US county records systems



What Makes This Role Different:

- Structured, repeatable work. This is not a "wear many hats" VA role. You'll do the same workflow every day and get faster at it every week.

- Clear ownership. You own the pipeline. Your numbers (hit rate, dead phone rate, on-time delivery) are visible to the team every Friday.

- Long-term growth. As we scale, you'll have the chance to train other VAs on this workflow and move into a team lead role.

You won't be making cold calls. This is back-office data work. We have a separate Acquisitions Team for outreach.



How to Apply

1. Include the word PIPELINE at the top of your application. Applications without this word will be deleted unread.

2. Briefly describe one time you cleaned a messy data set: what was wrong with it, how you fixed it, and how long it took.

3. Tell me what daily hours you would work in Philippine time.

4. Tell me your minimum acceptable hourly rate in USD.

5. Confirm you have a stable internet and a quiet workspace.



We will respond to the strongest applicants within 3 business days.



Thank you for reading the full post. We're looking forward to building a long-term team with the right person.

Skip Tracing & Contact Information Research

Returned Mail Management & Follow-Up

Call leads who have not responded to the mail campaign

Revisit leads that were marked as follow-up or not ready.

Reconnect with leads that went cold or stopped responding.

Excellent spoken English and communication skills.

Strong conversational and telephone skills.

Experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
Trademark Beauty | Full-Time | Remote (Philippines)



Salary: $1,000–$1,400 USD/month



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time



IMPORTANT: MINIMUM 3 YEARS OF PROFESSIONAL SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



Please do not apply unless you have at least 3 years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts for established brands or businesses. Personal social media experience alone does not qualify.



We are looking for someone who has already managed brand accounts, understands content strategy, and can independently execute a consistent social media calendar.



ABOUT TRADEMARK BEAUTY

Trademark Beauty is a fast-growing, Los Angeles-based beauty brand specializing in innovative, award-winning hair styling tools.



We’re a young, creative, personality-driven brand that loves beauty, trends, pop culture, and creating content that actually connects with our audience.



Our social media presence is a huge part of our business, and we’re looking for an experienced Social Media Manager who can help us continue growing.



We’re not looking for someone who just posts content. We want someone who understands what makes content engaging, knows how to communicate in a fun and relatable brand voice, and can take ownership of our day-to-day social media operations.



This is a hands-on role for someone who is creative, organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

1. Social Media Management & Scheduling

     Manage daily social media operations across Instagram and TikTok.

     Organize, maintain, and execute our social media content calendar using Notion.

     Schedule and publish content consistently across multiple brand accounts.

     Write engaging, on-brand captions, hooks, and calls to action.

     Ensure all content is properly formatted, tagged, and optimized for each platform.

     Coordinate content approvals and ensure posts go live on schedule.

     Repurpose existing content strategically across platforms.

     Maintain a consistent posting schedule of at least one post per account daily, with additional TikTok content as needed.

     Proactively identify content gaps and suggest ideas to keep our calendar full.



2. Content Planning & Creative Support

     Work with our existing library of professionally produced photos and videos to plan engaging content.

     Create simple, visually appealing graphics, Instagram Stories, and social assets using Canva.

     Identify opportunities to repurpose existing content into fresh, engaging posts.

     Stay on top of trending sounds, formats, memes, and beauty industry conversations.

     Develop creative content ideas that align with our brand personality and business goals.

     Collaborate with our internal team and video editor to coordinate upcoming content.

     Understand how to balance entertaining, educational, and product-focused content.



Please note: This is not a full-time video editing position. We have a dedicated video editor. However, you should be comfortable making simple edits and creating social graphics in Canva.



3. Community Management & Engagement

     Monitor and respond to comments and direct messages across our social channels.

     Engage with our audience in a friendly, authentic, and on-brand voice.

     Proactively interact with relevant creators, beauty accounts, and potential customers.

     Help build relationships with our followers through meaningful engagement.

     Identify opportunities to increase engagement, reach, and community growth.

     Escalate customer service inquiries or sensitive messages to the appropriate team member.



We want someone who understands that social media management isn’t just about posting. Building an engaged community is equally important.



4. Creator Relationships, Gifting & Affiliate Support

      Identify relevant beauty, hair, and lifestyle creators who align with our brand.

      Assist with influencer outreach, product gifting, and creator relationship management.

      Coordinate gifting opportunities and follow up with creators.

      Maintain organized records of creator outreach and collaborations.

      Help identify creators who could become long-term brand advocates.

      Support affiliate initiatives and TikTok Shop creator relationships.



Experience with TikTok Shop is preferred but not required. We’re happy to help train the right candidate on our TikTok Shop processes.



5. Social Media Growth & Performance

     Monitor social media performance, including engagement, reach, views, and follower growth.

     Identify top-performing content and recommend ways to replicate its success.

     Research competitors, emerging trends, and opportunities for growth.

     Provide simple, actionable performance updates.

     Proactively recommend improvements to our content strategy.



We value someone who can recognize what’s working and make thoughtful recommendations—not someone who simply reports numbers.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

You MUST meet the following requirements to be considered:

> 3+ years of professional social media management experience managing accounts for brands or businesses.

> Proven experience managing Instagram and TikTok, including content planning, scheduling, publishing, and engagement.

> Experience using Notion to manage content calendars, tasks, and workflows.

> Proficiency in Canva for creating social media graphics, Stories, and simple creative assets.

> Excellent written English, with the ability to write engaging, natural, conversational captions.

> Strong understanding of current social media trends, particularly within beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer brands.

> Experience with community management, including responding to comments, messages, and proactive audience engagement.

> Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts and deadlines.

> Ability to work independently, take initiative, and execute tasks without constant supervision.

> Availability to work full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time.

> Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.



PREFERRED (BUT NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience working with beauty, haircare, fashion, or e-commerce brands.

- Experience with TikTok Shop, including product tagging, affiliate programs, or creator outreach.

- Experience coordinating influencer gifting campaigns.

- Familiarity with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

- Experience using AI tools to assist with brainstorming, copywriting, or content planning.

- Experience managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Our ideal candidate is someone who:

> Gets our brand voice. You’re fun, creative, conversational, and understand how to make a beauty brand feel relatable rather than overly corporate.

> Is an executor. You don’t spend days researching what could be done. You know how to turn ideas into scheduled, published content.

> Is highly organized. You love a well-maintained content calendar and know how to keep things moving.

> Takes initiative. You spot opportunities, solve problems, and make recommendations without waiting to be asked.

> Understands social media culture. You know what’s trending, what feels outdated, and what makes people stop scrolling.

> Is detail-oriented. You catch mistakes, double-check captions and links, and take pride in your work.

> Enjoys engaging with people. You’re comfortable interacting with our community and helping build genuine relationships.



We’re a small, collaborative team, so communication, accountability, and a positive attitude are extremely important.



POSITION DETAILS

Position: Social Media Manager

Company: Trademark Beauty

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time (including a one-hour break)

Compensation: $1,000–$1,400 USD per month, depending on experience

Start Date: As soon as possible



This is a dedicated full-time position. We are looking for someone who can fully commit to the role during scheduled working hours.



HOW TO APPLY 

Please submit the following:

> Your Resume

Include your relevant professional social media management experience.



> Your Portfolio

Share examples of Instagram and TikTok accounts you have professionally managed. Please clearly explain your responsibilities for each account.



> Your Experience

Briefly answer the following questions:

- How many years have you professionally managed social media accounts for brands or businesses?

- Which Instagram and TikTok accounts have you managed?

- How have you used Notion and Canva in your previous roles?

- Have you managed community engagement, creator outreach, or influencer gifting?

- Do you have any experience with TikTok Shop? (Not required.)

- Are you available to work full-time from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time?

- What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



A Short Introduction

Tell us why you think you’d be a great fit for Trademark Beauty and what excites you about working with a beauty brand.

Applications without relevant professional experience or examples of previously managed brand accounts will not be considered. We’re excited to find someone who can grow with our team and help take Trademark Beauty’s social media presence to the next level!

title: Part-time Instagram / Reels / LinkedIn / TikTok Content Producer
description:
Part-Time Instagram Content Creator / Reels Specialist — Faceless B2B Content



Location: Remote

Hours: 10 hours per week

Pay: $4–$9 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience, skills, portfolio quality, and overall value



About the Role:



USA Growth Project provides fractional CFO services. A fractional CFO gives businesses strategic financial leadership on a part-time or outsourced basis.



We are looking for a creative, dependable Instagram content creator to help us reach business owners, founders, CEOs, and other decision-makers. Your work will help build awareness and trust in USA Growth Project and encourage suitable prospects to inquire about our services.



We are looking for a good balance of experience and value. You do not need to be the most senior candidate to apply.



Important: This is a faceless, company-focused role. The business owner will not show their face or appear on camera in posts or Reels. Content should focus on USA Growth Project and useful business insights, rather than the owner’s personal identity.



Content formats may include branded graphics, educational carousels, text-on-screen Reels, animated charts, licensed stock footage, screen recordings using approved or fictional data, and appropriate AI-assisted Instagram Reels, visuals or narration.



What You’ll Do:



Research topics relevant to business owners who may benefit from fractional CFO services.

Suggest content ideas and maintain a practical content calendar.

Create and edit faceless Instagram Reels, graphics, and educational carousel posts.

Write clear hooks, engaging captions, and appropriate calls to action.

Repurpose a core idea into different formats when useful.

Follow brand guidelines and submit content for approval before publication.

Review basic performance data and share a short weekly update.

Communicate clearly, meet agreed deadlines, and incorporate feedback.



Required Qualifications:



Fluent written and spoken English, including spoken English that is clear and understandable.

Demonstrated experience creating Instagram posts and short-form videos or Reels.

Ability to produce professional-looking faceless content.

Graphic design, video editing, and caption-writing skills.

Reliable communication, good time management, and the ability to work independently.

Willingness to follow instructions and accept constructive feedback.



Preferred, but Not Required:



Familiarity with Higgsfield AI, HeyGen, or similar AI content-creation tools.

Experience with tools such as Canva, CapCut, or Instagram / TikTok / Linked In / Youtube content generating software.

Experience creating content for B2B, finance, accounting, consulting, or other professional-services businesses.

Familiarity with Instagram analytics and content designed to encourage inquiries from suitable prospects.



Content Standards:



Our content should be educational, professional, and focused on the USA Growth Project brand. You should check AI-generated content for accuracy before submitting it, use appropriately licensed images, music, footage, and other assets, and protect confidential business and client information.



You are not expected to act as a CFO or provide individualized financial advice.



Hours, Compensation, and Workload:



This remote position is for 10 hours per week, at $4–$9 USD per hour. The rate will depend on relevant experience, skills, portfolio quality, and overall value.



We want to agree on a realistic workload rather than set an arbitrary number of posts. In your application, please tell us what you believe you can produce in 10 hours per week, including research, revisions, communication, and basic reporting.



How to Apply:



Please submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph and include all of the following:



1. Your resume or CV.

2. A description of your relevant experience, especially creating Instagram posts, Reels, and faceless content.

3. A link to an approximately two-minute audio or video introduction. Tell us a little about yourself and your experience. This audio or video recording will only be used to assess whether your spoken English is clear and understandable. 

4. A portfolio or links to relevant work samples, preferably including faceless short-form videos and Instagram posts. If you cannot share client work, you may share work you have permission to show or clearly labeled sample work.

5. Your desired hourly rate in USD, availability for 10 hours per week, and time zone.

6. A short list of tools you have used, noting any experience with Higgsfield AI, Canva, or HeyGen.

7. Your suggested realistic weekly output for this role within 10 hours.

Please make sure we can access your links without requesting permission. Your recording does not need to be publicly posted; an accessible unlisted or link-sharing option is fine.



Please do not send sensitive personal information, such as identification numbers or bank details, with your application. We assess spoken English based on understandable communication relevant to the role, not on accent. 



We look forward to learning about your experience and seeing your work.

title: Virtual Assistant – AI-Powered Support
description:
Grow Your Career With Us

We help driven Virtual Professionals grow their skills, contribute with purpose, and build careers with greater freedom and balance.



We're hiring Virtual Professionals who are ready to work alongside AI – not just use it, but let it think with them – to provide dependable, high-leverage support to founders and executives while helping organize the systems behind their day-to-day work.



This isn't a role defined by one tool or one title. It's defined by how you think, how fast you learn, and how well you hold things steady when it matters. If you're the kind of person who can pick up a new platform in a day, stay calm when a deadline is closing in, and bring good judgment to problems no one wrote a script for, we want to talk to you.



“We need someone who can hold and paddle the canoe steadily for years – someone who can push it to shore despite the big waves and bad weather, and won't tip the canoe over.”



What We're Looking For

We screen every applicant against five things. Tools and platforms can be taught – these can't:

• Core Values – five values, lived daily, not just posted on a wall (see below).

• Communication Skills – clear, proactive, and professional, in writing and in conversation.

• Strategic Thinking – you don't just complete tasks, you notice the pattern behind them and improve it.

• Learning Agility – you pick up new tools and AI platforms quickly and aren't afraid of the unfamiliar.

• Grace Under Pressure – you stay steady and hit deadlines even when things get chaotic.

AI fluency is a plus, but we can teach it. What we can't teach is the five things above.



Our Core Values

• Batteries Included – bring initiative, readiness, and a constructive attitude. Come prepared, look for solutions, and move work forward without needing constant reminders.

• Elevate – keep raising the quality of your work. Welcome feedback, develop your skills, and leave things better than you found them.

• Community – support one another's success. Share knowledge, offer help, communicate respectfully, and contribute to a team where people feel valued.

• Innovate – look for better ways to work. Stay curious, suggest improvements, and explore tools, including AI, that can make work more effective.

• Ownership – take responsibility for your commitments and results. Follow through, communicate obstacles early, and acknowledge mistakes with a plan to correct them.



What You Can Expect

• Remote, flexible work with a growing, systems-minded team

• Real ownership over the work you do, not busywork

• A team that's actively building with AI, not just talking about it

• Paid holidays and PTO, weekends off

• HMO after your first year, plus a Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG and referral incentives

• Free learning sessions and room to grow your skills and career over time



Compensation

Training rate starts at $5–$7/hr, with rate discussions after your first few weeks based on fit and performance.



How to Apply

Apply through this posting and complete the short assessment that follows – it's how we get to know how you think, not just what's on your resume.



Currently Hiring For

Executive Assistant – Marketing and Executive Assistant – Finance / Revenue Operations roles. Your specific placement will be determined after the assessment and interview process, based on where your strengths are the best fit.

description:
We're looking for an experienced video editor who can take raw footage and transform it into high-performing, disruptive social media content. You know how to find the key narrative moments in a long interview, craft compelling storylines, motion graphics, and sound design, and deliver polished multi-platform video assets tailored for maximum engagement.



About the company:

Navara works with energy and home service brands that provide fuel, hvac maintenance and more. As our Social Media Video Editor, you'll edit 20–30 short-form videos a month for our clients: interview cutdowns, customer-service explainers and "why choose us" brand videos. You'll take direction straight from our Project Manager and work as part of our Execution Team.



We move fast, especially in peak season (think winter storms for customers that use heating oil to warm their home). Volume goes up and down. Hitting deadlines and keeping to your hours matters.





Responsibilities:

Work directly with Client Partners: take their feedback, ask questions early, and turn revisions around fast.

Keep files organized and named the same way every time, so anyone on the team can find them.

Track your work, deadlines, and hours.

Stay current on what's working in social video: hooks, formats, trends and platform changes. Bring ideas to Client Partners when something could make a video perform better.



Qualifications:

4+ years editing short-form social video content (agency or client-facing experience required).

An advanced portfolio demonstrating mastery in short-form storytelling, dynamic motion graphics, and audio mix/sound design, including interview cutdowns.

Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.

Solid foundation in color grading, audio cleanup/mixing, and visual effects (VFX).

Comfortable with Canva for simple graphics.

Knows how vertical video works: hooks in the first 2 seconds, captions on screen, reframing for each size.

Bonus: experience with energy, HVAC, propane, heating oil, or other home service brands.

Bonus: motion graphics or After Effects skills.





Able to collaborate effectively as part of a team and discuss client strategies together.

Strong creative and strategic point of view.

High level of English proficiency sufficient to actively participate in team meetings.



About You:

You do what you say you'll do, on time.

Takes feedback well and doesn't need hand-holding on revisions.

Detail-driven. You catch the typo in the caption before the client does.

title: Project Manager
description:
ABOUT US



Kipkeh Media is an expanding US-based media network specializing in vlogs, local business features, promotional videos, and community-focused content.



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and resourceful Project Manager to oversee our day-to-day production operations, coordinate a remote team, and ensure projects move efficiently from planning to completion.



This role requires more than task delegation and deadline monitoring. We need someone who can take a big-picture view, stay several steps ahead, recognize potential bottlenecks, and make informed decisions to keep the entire operation organized and productive.



The right candidate is a natural planner who takes responsibility, works independently, and knows how to keep people and projects moving in the right direction.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Production & Project Coordination: Manage the complete content production cycle, covering raw material collection, editing, quality checks, approvals, and publishing. Coordinate several ongoing projects, set schedules, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.



Remote Team Leadership: Supervise and coordinate remote personnel, including content creators, intake specialists, and video editors. Assign responsibilities, establish clear expectations, address workflow concerns, and maintain consistent team accountability.



Strategic Planning & Execution: Stay ahead of upcoming assignments, anticipate possible delays, and identify scheduling or resource conflicts early. Organize priorities, make necessary adjustments, and take action before small issues develop into larger operational problems.



Production & Quality Control: Oversee incoming content and production progress, identify areas requiring attention, and communicate specific feedback or editing directions. Ensure the team follows established workflows, production guidelines, and quality standards.



Performance Tracking & Reporting: Keep project management sheets, production calendars, and task trackers accurate and organized. Monitor completion rates, communicate progress, flag outstanding work, and identify opportunities to improve team productivity and operational efficiency.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- At least 2 years of relevant experience in project management, operations management, or production coordination.

- Previous experience supervising remote employees and handling multiple projects at once.

- Excellent planning, organizational, and scheduling capabilities.

- A self-driven professional who anticipates what needs to be done rather than waiting for instructions.

- Strong decision-making, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to lead people, manage changing workloads, and work with minimal supervision.

- Open to constructive feedback and committed to professional development.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working with Google Workspace, Slack, and project management platforms.

- Background in media production, content operations, or video editing workflows is an advantage.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this position means having a well-coordinated production operation where projects progress according to schedule, team members understand their responsibilities, and potential issues are addressed before they disrupt the workflow.



We want someone who can independently recognize the next steps, maintain operational structure, and make sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



Most importantly, we value someone who brings initiative, sound judgment, accountability, and practical solutions to the team.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



- $5.00–$6 USD/hour, depending on experience and capabilities.

- Full-time position, 40 hours per week.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Weekly payments through Wise.

- Opportunity for professional development and career advancement as the company grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read and follow the application requirements below.



 Subject: Project Manager - Your Full Name



Submit ONE Google Drive or iCloud link(with sharing permissions set to "Anyone with the link can view") containing the following:



1. Updated Resume/CV outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.

2. Screenshot of your computer specifications (16GB RAM or higher preferred).

3. Screenshots of your primary and backup internet speed test results.

4. A photo of your dedicated home office or workstation.

5. Evidence of your backup power arrangement (UPS, power station, generator, or solar system).



We are looking for someone dependable, organized, forward-thinking, and comfortable taking responsibility for keeping a growing production team running efficiently.

If you have the experience, initiative, and leadership approach we're looking for, we would be glad to hear from you. Please ensure that your application includes all the requested information and follows the submission instructions above.

title: CREATIVE AI VIDEO EDITOR | E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME
description:
CREATIVE AI VIDEO EDITOR | E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME



Brand: Women’s Jewelry

Pay: $2,000/month base + performance bonuses, up to $4,000/month total

Commitment: 40 hours per week, exclusive to our brand



THE ROLE



We’re looking for a creative, versatile video editor with advanced AI production skills and a strong understanding of direct-response advertising.



You’ll work to create short-form Meta and TikTok ads using custom footage, AI-generated content, or both. Your work should capture attention, communicate our products’ value, and drive purchases.



Formats include AI podcast ads, realistic AI UGC, street interviews, song ads, Pixar-style animation, product demonstrations, and hybrid edits.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Relevant experience: At least 2 years editing e-commerce video ads for Meta and TikTok, supported by a strong portfolio.



• Advanced AI skills: Hands-on proficiency with Higgsfield or comparable platforms, including generating and refining video, images, voices, music, and lip sync.



• Creative range: Ability to produce different editing styles and turn briefs into complete ads, including generating assets from scratch.



• Direct-response knowledge: Strong hooks, clear benefits, effective pacing, readable captions, sound design, and compelling CTAs.



• Efficient execution: Ability to apply strategist feedback, meet deadlines, and quickly produce meaningful variations based on performance insights.



• Technical proficiency: Strong skills in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software. CapCut proficiency is a major plus.



• Attention to detail: Natural-looking AI outputs, accurate jewelry designs and gold tones, error-free text, and correct aspect ratios and safe zones.



• Accountability: Clear English communication, organized project files, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of quality.



OUR CUSTOM FOOTAGE LIBRARY



We have an extensive library of original, custom footage. You must familiarize yourself with it quickly, select the strongest scenes for each concept, and creatively combine clips into engaging ads that convert.



Repeatedly recycling the same handful of clips while relevant footage goes unused makes a lack of preparation apparent. Editors who consistently fail to explore and use our assets effectively will not continue in the role.



WORKING EXPECTATIONS AND TOOLS



• Exclusive commitment: No other jobs, freelance clients, or agency commitments. Individual applicants only; outsourcing is not permitted.



• Hubstaff: All hours worked must be tracked, with work activity monitoring enabled.



• U.S. working-hour overlap: Will be discussed once hired.



• AI subscriptions: All subscriptions needed for the role will be provided.



COMPENSATION AND BONUSES

Bonuses are available for up to two qualifying winning ads per month. Each qualifying ad must have at least $10,000 in ad spend and at least 14 days active.



Bonus per qualifying ad:



• 2.00–2.49 ROAS: $500

• 2.50–2.99 ROAS: $750

• 3.00+ ROAS: $1,000



Maximum monthly bonus: $2,000.

Maximum total monthly compensation: $4,000.



HOW TO APPLY



You MUST use a minimum of 10 Apply Points. Applications submitted with fewer than 10 Apply Points will not be reviewed or considered.



Include all of the following:



1) Your resume/CV and portfolio: Direct links to your strongest e-commerce ads for Meta or TikTok.



2) Two AI ad examples in different formats: Include one realistic human-led ad, such as UGC, a podcast, or a street interview, and one different format, such as animation or a song ad. For each, explain your contribution, tools used, and approximate production time.



3) Your workflow: Explain how you create a 15–45-second ad from a brief, including projects without usable source footage, and how you handle feedback and rapid iterations.



4) Your toolkit: List your editing and AI software, describe your Higgsfield and CapCut experience, and explain your preferred AI tools and why.



5) Your availability and confirmations: State your earliest start date and confirm your commitment to 40 exclusive hours per week, Hubstaff tracking and monitoring, and an unpaid practical editing exercise using footage provided.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to walk us through one portfolio project. Applications must include the requested materials and confirmations to be considered.

title: Media & Administrative Operations Specialist
description:
ABOUT KIPKEH MEDIA



Kipkeh Media is a growing US-based digital media network and communication brand serving the Orthodox Jewish community. We create and publish daily video stories, promotional materials, graphics, and community-focused content through a fast-paced, time-sensitive publishing operation.



We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented, and proactive Operations & Media Specialist to support our daily production activities, manage administrative workflows, coordinate with clients and vendors, and ensure that important tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a structured environment, takes pride in staying organized, and can independently manage responsibilities without needing constant supervision.



We value people who think ahead, communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and understand the importance of consistency in a growing operation.



THE WORKING ENVIRONMENT



Our operation follows established workflows, daily publishing schedules, and clearly defined responsibilities. Since many of our activities are time-sensitive, we need someone who can manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and reliability.



We encourage team members to take initiative, raise concerns early, and suggest better ways of handling daily tasks.



You will be given processes, expectations, and the necessary tools to perform your responsibilities. In return, we expect you to manage your workload responsibly, maintain regular communication, and follow through on commitments.



This is a full-time position intended for someone who can give their working hours consistent attention and build a long-term working relationship with the company.



2-WEEK PAID TRIAL PERIOD



All new team members begin with a 2-week paid evaluation period at the agreed hourly rate of $4.00–$5.00 USD, based on experience, for 40 hours per week.



The purpose of this period is to understand your working style, evaluate your ability to handle actual responsibilities, and ensure that the position is a good fit for both parties.



During the trial, we will assess:



Initiative & Ownership:Your ability to manage assigned responsibilities, anticipate upcoming tasks, ask questions when necessary, and follow through without repeated reminders.



Reliability & Communication: Consistent attendance, punctuality, responsiveness on Slack, and proper communication during shift transitions.



Organization & Tracking:Your ability to maintain accurate Google Sheets, update task statuses, organize files, and keep relevant records current.



Work Quality & Efficiency: Your ability to prepare content, perform basic video edits, and complete daily assignments accurately within the required timelines.



Candidates who successfully complete the evaluation period will transition into an ongoing, long-term full-time position.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



WhatsApp Status Content Preparation & Scheduling: Organize, prepare, and schedule daily WhatsApp Status videos and graphics. Verify content sequencing, branding, and publishing schedules to ensure materials are ready within designated posting windows.



Basic Video Editing & Quality Control: Use CapCut to trim raw footage, remove unnecessary pauses, adjust video formats, and apply approved logos, introductions, and watermarks using existing templates. Advanced video editing skills are not required; accuracy, consistency, and efficiency are the priorities.



Client & Vendor Coordination: Communicate with clients and external vendors to request creative materials, confirm content requirements, collect missing information, and provide timely updates regarding ongoing deliverables.



Payment Monitoring & Follow-Ups: Track outstanding client balances, verify payment statuses, coordinate payment-related updates, and send professional follow-ups when invoices remain unpaid.



Tracker & File Management: Maintain organized and accurate Google Sheets, production trackers, shared folders, and task records. Ensure information is updated consistently so the team has clear visibility into ongoing work.



Task Planning & Deadline Management: Monitor upcoming assignments, maintain personal task lists and calendar reminders, and ensure deliverables are completed ahead of or within their deadlines.



Slack Communication & Shift Reporting: Monitor assigned Slack channels, respond to relevant requests, coordinate communications, and prepare clear shift handoff reports for the Operations Manager.



Problem Identification & Escalation: Identify missing files, unclear instructions, broken links, and potential delays early. Communicate concerns promptly and take appropriate steps to prevent work from being delayed.



POSITION DETAILS



- Position:Operations & Media Specialist

- Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

- Working Hours: 40 hours per week

- Compensation: $4.00–$5.00 USD/hour, depending on experience and capabilities

- Payment: Weekly through Wise

- Work Schedule:Sunday night through Thursday night (EST)

Number of Candidates We’re Looking For: 2 (Shift A and Shift B)



Available Shifts:

- Shift 1: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

- Shift 2: 3:00 AM – 12:00 PM EST



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Relevant Experience

- At least 1–2 years of experience supporting US-based businesses, agencies, or entrepreneurs in an operations, administrative, media, or virtual assistance capacity.

- Previous experience working with remote teams and handling recurring operational responsibilities.

- Experience communicating directly with US clients is strongly preferred.



Technical & Software Skills

- Video Editing:Practical experience using CapCut for trimming footage, removing dead space, adjusting aspect ratios, and adding logos or watermarks.

- Design Tools: Familiarity with Canva for basic graphics and content preparation.

-Google Workspace: Proficient in Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Drive, and Gmail.

- Communication & Project Management: Comfortable using Slack and online task management platforms to coordinate assignments and maintain workflow visibility.



Professional Skills

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

- Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

- Comfortable communicating professionally with clients and following up on pending items.

- Able to manage personal schedules, task lists, and deadlines independently.

- Detail-oriented, dependable, and capable of handling several ongoing responsibilities.

- Willing to learn established processes, accept feedback, and contribute ideas for improvement.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



- $4.00–$5.00 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience and capabilities.

- Guaranteed 40 working hours per week.

- Weekly payments through Wise.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Consistent work and an opportunity to establish a long-term position.

- Opportunity to develop additional operational and media management skills as the company grows.



HOW TO APPLY



We appreciate applicants who take the time to prepare complete, organized, and thoughtful applications. Please review the requirements below before submitting.



 Subject: [Your Full Name] – Media & Administrative



Please submit ONE Google Drive, iCloud, or other accessible cloud link containing the following documents and information. Ensure that the sharing permissions allow anyone with the link to view the files.



1. Updated Resume/CV

- Include your relevant work experience, previous US clients, responsibilities, and software proficiency.



3. Video Editing Samples

4. Computer & Internet Specifications

- Identify your secondary internet connection or backup internet solution.



IMPORTANT:Please double-check that your submitted links are accessible before sending your application. Incomplete applications or inaccessible supporting documents may affect the evaluation process.



We are looking forward to meeting professionals who take pride in their work, value accountability, and want to contribute to a growing media operation. If you have relevant experience, enjoy working in a structured environment, and are confident in your ability to manage responsibilities independently, we encourage you to apply. We would be happy to learn more about your experience and what you can bring to the team.

title: senior operations manager, hospitality (airbnb experience) | remote, flexible hours | usd 2,000 to 3,000
description:
hyperstay rents entire furnished houses in san francisco to startup teams for one to six months. our guests are founders who just raised a round or just finished an accelerator. they are busy building their companies and they expect the house to simply work.



we are hiring a senior operations manager to run the operation end to end, reporting directly to the founder. today the founder is still the person who gets the call when something breaks. your job is to make that stop. within a few months you should be running the houses better than he does.



what you will own

- the guest experience end to end: every message, every check-in, every problem, every review

- emergencies at any hour. you are the escalation point and you make the call

- the field team: cleaners, handymen and vendors. scheduling, quality, costs and accountability

- the calendar: booking requests, leads, pricing checks and occupancy

- the numbers: operating spreadsheets, monthly owner reports, contractor invoices and budgets

- the system itself: you write the playbooks, fix what keeps breaking and automate what can be automated

- the team as it grows: you will help hire and lead future coordinators



how the work is organized

- this is not a 9 to 5. nobody watches your clock. you organize your own day around what the houses need

- you need at least 4 hours of live overlap with san francisco business hours every working day (9am to 5pm pacific, which is about 1am to 9am in manila). the rest you plan yourself

- outside your working hours you stay reachable. real emergencies are rare, a few times a month, but when a guest is locked out at 3am your time, you pick up and you fix it

- days off are planned in advance and the founder covers for you



what we are looking for

- 5+ years of experience, including at least 2 running operations for a hospitality, property or service business

- you have managed vendors or a team and held them to a standard

- excellent written and spoken english

- strong with numbers and spreadsheets. you can read a p&l and find the mistake in a report

- you have built a process from zero and can show it

- judgment. you know which decisions are yours and which ones need the founder

- reliable internet, a backup connection, backup power, a quiet place for calls and your own computer

- this would be your only job

- spanish or portuguese is a plus, since part of our field team speaks them



this role is not for you if

- you want fixed hours and to be unreachable outside them

- you want to manage from a distance. this is hands on

- a phone call in the middle of the night would make you resent the job



what you get

- usd 2,000 to 3,000 per month depending on experience, paid in dollars

- fully remote, flexible hours

- full ownership of the operation and a direct line to the founder

- a long term role as an independent contractor, with room to build and lead a team

4. a paid trial project of two weeks. we never ask for free work, and you do not have to quit anything before we both know it is a fit

Either way, you own the result.



When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result.





Operating Rules

Own the result. Do not pass problems.

Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility.

Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist.

No proof = not done.

Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit.

No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan.

Bring solutions. If leadership must d
, bring the options and your recommendation.

Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?”

Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require.



What You Own



1. Property & Rent-Ready Execution



Drive property work from problem to verified completion.



Examples:

Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready.

Coordinate cleanouts.

Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved.

Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof.



The process is: Problem → Owner → Quote → Approval if needed → Schedule → Execute → Verify → Close



Every unavailable unit must have a reason, owner, next action, and deadline.



Do not report that a unit is stuck.



Get it unstuck.



2. BOTG & Vendor Management



Own the people who execute work locally.

Find and hire BOTG and vendors.

Give clear scopes and deadlines.

Get quotes.

Follow up.

Verify work.

Correct poor work.

Replace underperformers.

Maintain backup options.



“I asked them” is not a result.



The work being completed correctly is the result.



3. Projects & Procurement

Own independent projects from idea to completion.



Examples include:

Source and purchase supplies or equipment.

Order signs, locks, parts, cameras, and materials.

Research and negotiate vendors or services.

Sell unused assets.

Coordinate property improvement projects.

Build new operational processes.

Complete one-off projects leadership assigns.



You are expected to figure out the path forward without needing step-by-step direction.



4. Operational Problem Resolution

When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution.

Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution.

Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions.

Once the decision is made, you own getting it done.



What Winning Looks Like

Work gets completed on time.

Projects do not stall.

Rent-Ready units do not sit because nobody followed through.

Vendors and BOTG are held accountable.

Problems are surfaced before deadlines are missed.

Completed work is actually complete.

Asana reflects reality.

Recurring work becomes simpler and requires less manual effort.



This Role Is a Fit If You

Are a doer.

Take ownership without reminders.

Finish what you start.

Can manage a small team and still execute personally.

Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out.

Follow up relentlessly.

Make good decisions independently.

Keep many moving pieces organized.

Communicate problems early.

Hold vendors and teammates accountable.

Care about details and proof.

Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems.



Own the result, not the clock. Do what it takes to get the job done. Then improve the system so the same result takes less time and effort next time.



How to Apply

Please submit:

-Your current resume.

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.
